sys_update_xml.payload: custom * via $http.get() under a LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS deadline. * On success (HTTP 200 with a status), sets c.result * with the strict 3-field whitelist. On a 4xx, sets * c.notFound = true so the verbatim not-found message * is rendered. On a 5xx, a network failure or a * timeout, sets c.errorMessage instead, because in * those cases nothing was learned about the case. * * Design rationale: * - controller-as syntax (`var c = this`) per AAP Section 0.5.1's * widget-authoring conventions and per the sibling confirmation * widget at ./sp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_confirmation_widget.xml. * - $http (NOT fetch): Service Portal widgets run in AngularJS * 1.5.x context; $http is the canonical HTTP client. fetch() * would bypass AngularJS's digest cycle and require manual * $scope.$apply() handling. * - encodeURIComponent on the case number: defensive URL escaping. * Even though normal case numbers (CASE0000001) contain no * special characters, defensive encoding prevents URL-injection * attacks if a malicious user submits a crafted string. * - Strict 3-field whitelist on response.data: defense-in-depth. * Even if the server's response somehow contained additional * fields (e.g., due to a future refactor of the Script Include), * this client controller extracts ONLY status/subject/opened_date * so no internal data leaks to the template. * - Verbatim error message in template, NOT echoed from server: * the message "No case found with that number." (AAP Section * 0.7.4) is hardcoded in the template via ng-if="c.notFound". * This controller deliberately does NOT pass error.data.error * or error.statusText to the template - the server's error * body is NEVER trusted by the client. * - Identical handling of 404 and 400: information-leakage * hardening. Both set c.notFound = true, so an attacker cannot * distinguish "case not found" from "invalid input" and learns * nothing about the accepted shape of a case number. This does * NOT remove the hit/miss oracle inherent to the AAP Section * 0.7.4 single-factor lookup - a real number answers 200 with the * case's three fields - see the HTTP-ERROR HARDENING section of * this record's header for the honest statement of that exposure * and the controls that compensate for it (review finding F07). * An HTTP 429 is handled separately, as a throttle rather than as * a not-found, and a 500, a network failure or an expired * deadline set c.errorMessage instead - in all of those the case * table was never consulted and the verbatim not-found text would * be a false statement about the requester's case. * - c.loading flag: prevents double-lookup race conditions if * the user clicks the button twice quickly, AND drives the * "Looking up..." button text for clear UX feedback. */ var c = this; /* * Deadline for the lookup request, in milliseconds. Chosen to sit well * above any normal round trip to the scripted REST endpoint (measured in * tens of milliseconds against the verification instance) while still * failing fast enough that a requester is not left staring at a disabled * button. See the comment at the $http.get call for why a deadline is * appropriate on this read and inappropriate on the sibling widget's POST. */ var LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 20000; // Lookup state. Initialize with safe defaults so the template's // ng-if expressions evaluate cleanly even before c.lookup() runs. c.caseNumber = ''; c.result = null; c.notFound = false; c.errorMessage = ''; c.loading = false; /** * Look up the status of a case by its number via the scripted REST * endpoint at /api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup. * * Per AAP Section 0.4.4: returns ONLY status, subject, opened_date * via strict 3-field whitelist on the response. * * Per AAP Section 0.7.4: on no-match (HTTP 404 or any other error), * the verbatim text "No case found with that number." is rendered * by the template. This function MUST NOT echo error.data.error or * any server-supplied text. */ c.lookup = function() { // Idempotent guard: prevent double-lookup if the user clicks // the button or presses Enter while a request is in flight. if (c.loading) { return; } // Empty-input guard: do not issue a request if the case number // is empty or whitespace-only. The button is also disabled in // this case via ng-disabled, but the guard provides defense- // in-depth in case the disabled state is bypassed (e.g., by // pressing Enter in some edge browsers). if (!c.caseNumber || String(c.caseNumber).trim() === '') { return; } // Reset state at the start of every lookup. The three outcome // panels are mutually exclusive: at most one of c.result, // c.notFound and c.errorMessage is truthy at any time. c.loading = true; c.result = null; c.notFound = false; c.errorMessage = ''; // Build the URL with defensive URL-encoding of the case number. // The server-side Script Include x_casemgmt.CasePortalService. // lookupCase() trims the value, upper-cases it, requires it to match // ^CASE[0-9]{7}$ BEFORE it issues any query, and then queries by the // case 'number' field - so anything this widget sends that is not a // well-formed case number is answered as a not-found without touching // the database. encodeURIComponent() handles any whitespace, special // characters, or potentially malicious input safely. var url = '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=' + encodeURIComponent(String(c.caseNumber).trim()); // The deadline below is what stops a lookup hanging indefinitely. // Without it, an unresponsive instance leaves c.loading true for as // long as the browser is willing to wait, the button stays disabled // reading "Looking up...", and the requester has no way to retry // short of reloading the page. On expiry AngularJS rejects the // promise with status 0, which the error handler reports as a // service failure rather than as a missing case. // // A deadline is safe HERE because this request is a read: retrying it // costs nothing and cannot duplicate anything. The sibling submission // widget deliberately does NOT set one on its POST, because a // submission that succeeds server-side just after the client gives up // would tell the requester it failed and invite a second press, which // is how duplicate cases get created. $http.get(url, { timeout: LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS }).then(function(response) { // Success path (HTTP 200). The server's REST operation // returns { status, subject, opened_date } per its contract - // but a ServiceNow Scripted REST API wraps whatever the // operation script passes to response.setBody() inside a // `result` envelope before it reaches the wire. Measured // against the live endpoint, a 200 body is // {"result":{"status":"Draft","subject":"...","opened_date":"..."}} // so the three whitelisted values live at // response.data.result.*, and reading response.data.* yields // undefined - which would have painted a result panel with // three blank rows instead of the case's status. // // The unwrap below prefers the envelope and falls back to the // bare body, so it is correct whether or not the envelope is // applied (the platform can be configured either way, and a // caller may append sysparm_no_envelope). c.loading = false; var body = (response && response.data && response.data.result) ? response.data.result : (response ? response.data : null); // `status` is mandatory on every case, so its presence is the // signal that a real record came back. An empty or // status-less body is treated as not-found rather than // rendered as a panel of blanks. if (body && body.status) { // Strict 3-field whitelist (defense-in-depth). Extract // ONLY status, subject, opened_date from the response // body. Even if the server were misconfigured to return // additional fields, this widget would not display them. // String() coercion handles undefined/null gracefully - // the template renders an empty cell rather than the // literal text "undefined" or "null". c.result = { status: String(body.status || ''), subject: String(body.subject || ''), opened_date: String(body.opened_date || '') }; c.notFound = false; } else { // Defensive: empty or status-less response body on HTTP // 200. Treat as not-found rather than rendering an empty // result panel. // This should not occur in practice (the server always // returns a body on 200) but guards against unexpected // upstream behavior. c.result = null; c.notFound = true; } }, function(error) { // Error path. Split in THREE, because a lookup that was // ANSWERED and found nothing, a lookup that was REFUSED, and a // lookup that was never answered at all are three different // facts and only one of them is a statement about the case. // // 429 -> the endpoint refused to answer: this session is over // its per-session lookup ceiling (the abuse control // added for review finding F07 in // ../../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml). // The case table was NEVER consulted, so this must not // render the not-found text - it renders the throttle // panel, telling the requester to wait and try again. // Checked FIRST, because 429 is inside the 4xx range // the not-found branch below would otherwise swallow. // other // 4xx -> the request reached the case table and no case with // that number came back. This is the not-found case, // and it renders the AAP Section 0.7.4 verbatim text. // A 400 maps here as well as a 404, so those two stay // indistinguishable to the caller and nothing // discloses the accepted shape of a case number. It // does NOT hide the difference between a case that // exists (HTTP 200 with three fields) and one that // does not - that oracle is inherent to the mandated // single-factor contract and is compensated // server-side; see this record's header. // 5xx, // 0/-1 -> the instance failed, the network failed, or the // deadline above expired. Nothing was learned about // the case, so claiming "No case found with that // number." would be a false statement about the // requester's case - and a costly one, because the // requester concludes their case does not exist. This // renders the separate service-failure panel instead. // // No branch echoes error.data.error, error.statusText or any // other server-supplied content: every message string is // hardcoded, in this controller and in the template. c.loading = false; c.result = null; var httpStatus = (error && typeof error.status === 'number') ? error.status : 0; if (httpStatus === 429) { c.notFound = false; c.errorMessage = 'Too many lookups from this session. Please wait a moment and try again.'; } else if (httpStatus >= 400 && httpStatus < 500) { c.notFound = true; c.errorMessage = ''; } else { c.notFound = false; c.errorMessage = 'The case service could not be reached. Please try again in a moment.'; } }); }; } ]]>csp_instanceCustom unauthenticated Service Portal widget for case status lookup. Renders a single case-number input field plus a Look Up Status button, GETs /api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup, and displays ONLY the whitelisted fields { status, subject, opened_date } on match or the verbatim text 'No case found with that number.' on no-match per AAP Section 0.7.4. Embedded by sp_page_x_casemgmt_case_status. No internal fields (assigned_group, assigned_agent, description, closed_date, requester_name, requester_email, priority, type, pending_reason, audit fields) are exposed. A 404 not-found and a 400 bad-request render the same verbatim no-case-found message, so neither the accepted shape of a case number nor the difference between a malformed and an unmatched value is disclosed; an HTTP 429 renders a distinct throttle panel and a 5xx, a network failure or an expired 20-second client deadline render a 'service could not be reached' panel, because in those cases nothing was learned about the case and the verbatim not-found message would be false. This widget does NOT eliminate the hit-versus-miss oracle inherent to the AAP Section 0.7.4 single-factor number-only lookup - a case that exists answers HTTP 200 with its three whitelisted fields - which is compensated server-side by strict ^CASE[0-9]{7}$ validation before any query, per-session sliding-window throttling answered as HTTP 429, abuse monitoring under the log marker X_CASEMGMT_PORTAL_LOOKUP_ABUSE|, and the native per-hour sys_rate_limit_rules ceiling on the guest user; the residual risk is recorded in docs/portal-pages.md (review finding F07). Replaces ArkCase's GetCaseByNumberServiceImpl.getCaseByNumber() and PortalRequestService.getRequestStatus() Spring services. No client-side or server-side database operations - all data flows through the scripted REST endpoint. Per AAP Sections 0.4.3, 0.4.4, 0.5.1, and 0.7.4 (verbatim no-case-found message) and Validation Gate 5 (Portal - lookup).falsex_casemgmt_case_lookup_widgetfalseCase Lookup Widget[]truefalsesp_widgetsystem2025-01-01 00:00:00e992deb0bd1657f36a38f5af6a46aeb20Case Lookup Widget82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5afsp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_lookup_widgetsystem2025-01-01 00:00:00

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>8</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>394419886dab25c08061380d73c8634b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_394419886dab25c08061380d73c8634b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 08 - Transition Draft to Open requires assigned_group">9eca1a92704f7acf745e7560fa46728a</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=394419886dab25c08061380d73c8634b"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>394419886dab25c08061380d73c8634b</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>039c1b81e7701d5869a02153fae3ea9f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "nogroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "83f3e6d3ff140821649d17368601a963",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-08",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-08 draft without a group",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>394419886dab25c08061380d73c8634b</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>33b5b0e3b12d005f2b77a0fdc2e38638</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

Data model: case, task and party schema per AAP 0.5.7">4779cf2ff32768ffd2afaee103133709</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=7a030ede995b70701f1fb9cc49e9e8be"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>7a030ede995b70701f1fb9cc49e9e8be</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>4361dd709950d6d31dd07ccd373459ed</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    // Every application-defined column on a table, sorted. The collection row
    // (element empty) and the platform's own inherited sys_* columns are excluded,
    // so what is left is exactly what this deliverable declares. Used for SET
    // EQUALITY, which is what makes an UNDECLARED extra field fail the test - a
    // per-field existence loop alone can never notice one.
    function appElements(table) {
        var out = [], d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table);
        d.addNotNullQuery('element');
        d.query();
        while (d.next()) {
            var e = d.getValue('element');
            if (e && e.indexOf('sys_') !== 0) { out.push(e); }
        }
        out.sort();
        return out;
    }

    var CASE_SPEC = [
        ['number','string',40,false,true], ['type','string',40,false,false],
        ['status','string',40,true,false], ['priority','string',40,false,false],
        ['subject','string',255,true,false], ['description','string',4000,true,false],
        ['opened_date','glide_date_time',40,false,true], ['closed_date','glide_date_time',40,false,true],
        ['assigned_group','reference',32,false,false], ['assigned_agent','reference',32,false,false],
        ['requester_name','string',100,true,false], ['requester_email','string',100,false,false],
        ['pending_reason','string',40,false,false]
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < CASE_SPEC.length; i++) {
        var sp = CASE_SPEC[i], d = dict('x_casemgmt_case', sp[0]);
        chkTrue('x_casemgmt_case.' + sp[0] + ' exists', !!d);
        if (!d) continue;
        chk('x_casemgmt_case.' + sp[0] + ' type', sp[1], d.getValue('internal_type'));
        chk('x_casemgmt_case.' + sp[0] + ' max_length', sp[2], d.getValue('max_length'));
        chk('x_casemgmt_case.' + sp[0] + ' mandatory', sp[3], d.getValue('mandatory') == '1');
        chk('x_casemgmt_case.' + sp[0] + ' read_only', sp[4], d.getValue('read_only') == '1');
    }
    chk('assigned_group reference target', 'sys_user_group', dict('x_casemgmt_case','assigned_group').getValue('reference'));
    chk('assigned_agent reference target', 'sys_user', dict('x_casemgmt_case','assigned_agent').getValue('reference'));
    chk('case.type choices', 'General Inquiry,Complaint', choices('x_casemgmt_case','type').join(','));
    chk('case.status choices', 'Draft,Open,In Progress,Pending,Resolved,Closed', choices('x_casemgmt_case','status').join(','));
    chk('case.priority choices', 'Low,Medium,High,Critical', choices('x_casemgmt_case','priority').join(','));
    chk('case.pending_reason choices', 'Awaiting Info,Awaiting Third Party,Other', choices('x_casemgmt_case','pending_reason').join(','));
    var num = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('fixture case is readable', num.get('cfdc67741a52236340f593d0229635a8'));
    chkTrue('generated number matches the CASE0000001 format', /^CASE[0-9]{7}$/.test(num.getValue('number')));
    var counter = new GlideRecord('sys_number');
    counter.addQuery('category', 'x_casemgmt_case'); counter.setLimit(1); counter.query();
    chkTrue('sys_number counter exists for x_casemgmt_case', counter.next());
    chk('number prefix', 'CASE', counter.getValue('prefix'));
    chk('number maximum_digits', '7', counter.getValue('maximum_digits'));
    // A new case must arrive at Draft from the DICTIONARY DEFAULT: step 1 does not
    // supply `status`, so this is the platform's own value, not an echo of the test.
    chk('a new case defaults to Draft (status was never supplied on insert)', 'Draft', num.getValue('status'));
    chk('x_casemgmt_case.status carries the Draft dictionary default',
        'Draft', dict('x_casemgmt_case', 'status').getValue('default_value'));
    chk('Draft is the first selectable status choice', 'Draft', choices('x_casemgmt_case', 'status')[0]);
    // EXACT FIELD SET, not merely "the declared ones exist". Any column that is not
    // on this list - a stray field added by hand, a leftover from an experiment, an
    // accidental extra in a future payload - breaks the assertion by name.
    var CASE_FIELDS = ['assigned_agent', 'assigned_group', 'closed_date', 'description',
        'duration_to_close', 'number', 'opened_date', 'pending_reason', 'priority',
        'requester_email', 'requester_name', 'status', 'subject', 'type'];
    chk('x_casemgmt_case carries EXACTLY the declared field set',
        CASE_FIELDS.join(','), appElements('x_casemgmt_case').join(','));
    chk('x_casemgmt_case field count', String(CASE_FIELDS.length), String(appElements('x_casemgmt_case').length));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('x_casemgmt_case schema (AAP 0.5.7): checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'x_casemgmt_case schema (AAP 0.5.7)', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>A Closed case</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b57565b62a726c52a4a9c9152cb98122</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_b57565b62a726c52a4a9c9152cb98122</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 14 - Prohibited transition: Closed is terminal">6fd42dceb3548cbb6e6535bd1df8c411</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=b57565b62a726c52a4a9c9152cb98122"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>b57565b62a726c52a4a9c9152cb98122</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>361060a8b003630c8e4a3d8c1a5f20a6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3ed0fd4998aa5a461d089e574c504954",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-14",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-14 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>The lookup returns the three whitelisted fields and leaks nothing else</notes><order>2</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>f95588a937f8fa5af17efdbe9e0f0560</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_f95588a937f8fa5af17efdbe9e0f0560</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date">6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=f95588a937f8fa5af17efdbe9e0f0560"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>f95588a937f8fa5af17efdbe9e0f0560</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9d31ee4a83b665a501d65dab6cce960d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>f95588a937f8fa5af17efdbe9e0f0560</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>f3139adedee47bdddb2e7fbfa6a10aff</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 07:08:21</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    function anonCall(method, path, body) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setHttpMethod(method);
        r.setEndpoint(String(gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri')).replace(/\/$/, '') + path);
        r.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        if (body) {
            r.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
            r.setRequestBody(body);
        }
        var resp = r.execute();
        return { status: String(resp.getStatusCode()), body: String(resp.getBody() || '') };
    }

    var fixture = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('fixture readable', fixture.get('07c9b35d04dc04336b72fa1a9c011e11'));
    var number = fixture.getValue('number');
    chkTrue('fixture number matches the CASE0000001 format', /^CASE[0-9]{7}$/.test(number));
    var res = anonCall('get', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=' + encodeURIComponent(number), null);
    chk('anonymous lookup status', '200', res.status);
    var body = JSON.parse(res.body).result;
    var keys = Object.keys(body).sort();
    chk('the response carries EXACTLY the three whitelisted keys', 'opened_date,status,subject', keys.join(','));
    chk('status is the stored status', fixture.getValue('status'), String(body.status));
    chk('subject is the stored subject', fixture.getValue('subject'), String(body.subject));
    // EXACT VALUE, not merely "populated". lookupCase() emits opened_date as the
    // DISPLAY value - String(caseGr.opened_date.getDisplayValue()) - see the block
    // comment at the return statement of
    // ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml: emitting the raw column
    // made this endpoint the ONLY surface in the application quoting UTC, so one
    // record read 17:39:40 externally and 10:39:40 on the internal form. AAP
    // Section 0.7.3 Gate 5 requires the CORRECT opened_date be returned, so the
    // display value is the correct emission and the raw column is not.
    //
    // This assertion previously expected the raw column and was left behind by
    // that fix. It now expects the display value - the contract the endpoint, the
    // lookup panel's "Opened Date" label and ../docs/portal-pages.md all state -
    // and it asserts BOTH halves of that contract, so a well-formed but WRONG
    // date still fails: (1) the emitted string is character for character the
    // display rendering of this very case's opened_date, and (2) read back through
    // the session timezone it denotes the same instant as the stored UTC column.
    // A "populated" check would have passed on any non-empty string - another
    // case's date or a placeholder - which is what AAP Section 0.7.4 requires this
    // test to exclude. Both comparisons render in the executing session's
    // timezone, as the endpoint itself does.
    var storedOpened = fixture.getValue('opened_date');
    var storedDisplay = String(fixture.opened_date.getDisplayValue() || '');
    chkTrue('the fixture has a stored opened_date to compare against',
        String(storedOpened || '').length > 0);
    chkTrue('the fixture opened_date renders a display value to compare against',
        storedDisplay.length > 0);
    chk('opened_date is EXACTLY the display rendering of the stored opened_date, character for character',
        storedDisplay, String(body.opened_date));
    var roundTrip = new GlideDateTime();
    roundTrip.setDisplayValue(String(body.opened_date));
    chk('the returned opened_date denotes the same instant as the stored UTC column',
        storedOpened, String(roundTrip.getValue()));
    chkTrue('the returned opened_date is a YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss datetime',
        /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$/.test(String(body.opened_date)));
    var FORBIDDEN = ["assigned_group", "assigned_agent", "description", "closed_date", "requester_name", "requester_email", "sys_id"];
    for (var i = 0; i < FORBIDDEN.length; i++) {
        chk('key ' + FORBIDDEN[i] + ' is absent from the parsed body', 'false',
            String(body.hasOwnProperty(FORBIDDEN[i])));
        chk('token ' + FORBIDDEN[i] + ' is absent from the raw body', '-1',
            String(res.body.indexOf(FORBIDDEN[i])));
    }
    chk('the assigned agent sys_id does not leak', '-1', String(res.body.indexOf(fixture.getValue('assigned_agent'))));
    chk('the case sys_id does not leak', '-1', String(res.body.indexOf(fixture.getUniqueValue())));
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends: emitted separately, the
    // response-body evidence below was written and then silently discarded, so the
    // run output never showed the payload these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('anonymous 200 body: ' + res.body);
    notes.push('opened_date compared exactly: stored_display[' + storedDisplay + '] returned[' + String(body.opened_date) + '] stored_utc[' + storedOpened + '] round_trip_utc[' + String(roundTrip.getValue()) + ']');
    notes.push('anonymous lookup of a valid number and the field whitelist: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'anonymous lookup of a valid number and the field whitelist', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Assert the AAP 0.5.6 child-table narrowing: each OR branch allows read/write independently, and the unassigned and nonmember-group parents deny read, write and delete</notes><order>3</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>1ff9b0dd8bcf320baed72fe347a420bd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_1ff9b0dd8bcf320baed72fe347a420bd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 07 - RBAC: agent ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write on task and party (AAP 0.5.6 mirror)">e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=1ff9b0dd8bcf320baed72fe347a420bd"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>1ff9b0dd8bcf320baed72fe347a420bd</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>3ec4bf178e345626ac34220917b89320</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>1ff9b0dd8bcf320baed72fe347a420bd</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9957831b39b5982f401a806fed5c9bfb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    var parentId = 'ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd';
    var parent = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('agent can read the parent case', parent.get(parentId));
    var tk = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case_task');
    chkTrue('agent can read a task on its assigned parent case', tk.get('ed02fff340bf0037625492f0cb259810'));
    if (tk.isValidRecord()) {
        chkTrue('agent canWrite that task', tk.canWrite());
        chk('agent canDelete that task', 'false', String(tk.canDelete()));
        chkTrue('agent canCreate tasks', tk.canCreate());
    }
    var pt = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case_party');
    chkTrue('agent can read a party on its assigned parent case', pt.get('41b752e01dd8d0f75ef3230a70b55d2c'));
    if (pt.isValidRecord()) {
        chkTrue('agent canWrite that party', pt.canWrite());
        chk('agent canDelete that party', 'false', String(pt.canDelete()));
        chkTrue('agent canCreate parties', pt.canCreate());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AAP 0.5.6 "Assigned only" is a DISJUNCTION on the parent case:
    //     assigned_agent = current user OR assigned_group contains current user
    // The fixture above satisfies BOTH halves at once, so on its own it cannot show
    // that either half works independently, and it cannot show the "only" at all.
    // The four parents below isolate each branch:
    //     direct      assigned_agent = the agent, assigned_group EMPTY   -> ALLOW
    //     group       assigned_group = the agent's team, no agent        -> ALLOW
    //     unassigned  neither field populated                            -> DENY
    //     othergroup  a group the agent is NOT a member of               -> DENY
    // Each carries its own task and party child, and each is asserted for read AND
    // write AND delete, so a fail-open ACL cannot hide behind the both-branch case.
    function childProbe(table, sysId) {
        var secure = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        var visible = secure.get(sysId);
        // A plain GlideRecord loads the row without applying the read ACL (measured),
        // which is the only way to ask the platform for its per-record write and delete
        // decisions on a row the identity may not see.
        var plain = new GlideRecord(table);
        var exists = plain.get(sysId);
        return {
            visible: visible, exists: exists,
            canRead: exists ? plain.canRead() : null,
            canWrite: exists ? plain.canWrite() : null,
            canDelete: exists ? plain.canDelete() : null
        };
    }
    var ALLOW = [
        ['direct-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', '74896b49d2174d3fbf07b0f3c0e13cfb'],
        ['direct-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', 'e1655540ada67a5667dea0cc155f2d04'],
        ['group-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', 'f3573645a8f769471a11daeeb63a75b1'],
        ['group-assigned', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', 'd97f9690087d07b7e9a2633a357fbd28']
    ];
    var DENY = [
        ['unassigned-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', '255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5'],
        ['unassigned-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', '84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629'],
        ['nonmember-group-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_task', 'd0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306'],
        ['nonmember-group-parent', 'x_casemgmt_case_party', '1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9']
    ];
    var a, p;
    for (a = 0; a < ALLOW.length; a++) {
        var okCase = ALLOW[a], okName = okCase[0] + ' ' + okCase[1];
        p = childProbe(okCase[1], okCase[2]);
        chkTrue('fixture exists: ' + okName, p.exists);
        chkTrue('ALLOW read (' + okName + ')', p.visible);
        chkTrue('ALLOW canRead (' + okName + ')', p.canRead);
        chkTrue('ALLOW canWrite (' + okName + ')', p.canWrite);
        chk('DENY canDelete - the agent never deletes (' + okName + ')', 'false', String(p.canDelete));
    }
    for (var dn = 0; dn < DENY.length; dn++) {
        var noCase = DENY[dn], noName = noCase[0] + ' ' + noCase[1];
        p = childProbe(noCase[1], noCase[2]);
        chkTrue('fixture exists: ' + noName, p.exists);
        chk('DENY read (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.visible));
        chk('DENY canRead (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.canRead));
        chk('DENY canWrite (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.canWrite));
        chk('DENY canDelete (' + noName + ')', 'false', String(p.canDelete));
    }
    // Set-level narrowing: the allowed children must be inside the agent's visible
    // sets and the denied children must be outside them. GlideRecordSecure.getRowCount()
    // is NOT ACL-filtered, so the sets are built by iteration.
    function visibleIds(table) {
        var o = {}, g = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) { o[g.getUniqueValue()] = 1; }
        return o;
    }
    var visTask = visibleIds('x_casemgmt_case_task'), visParty = visibleIds('x_casemgmt_case_party');
    chkTrue('the direct-assigned task is in the visible task set', !!visTask['74896b49d2174d3fbf07b0f3c0e13cfb']);
    chkTrue('the group-assigned task is in the visible task set', !!visTask['f3573645a8f769471a11daeeb63a75b1']);
    chk('the unassigned-parent task is NOT in the visible task set', 'false',
        String(!!visTask['255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5']));
    chk('the nonmember-group task is NOT in the visible task set', 'false',
        String(!!visTask['d0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306']));
    chkTrue('the direct-assigned party is in the visible party set', !!visParty['e1655540ada67a5667dea0cc155f2d04']);
    chkTrue('the group-assigned party is in the visible party set', !!visParty['d97f9690087d07b7e9a2633a357fbd28']);
    chk('the unassigned-parent party is NOT in the visible party set', 'false',
        String(!!visParty['84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629']));
    chk('the nonmember-group party is NOT in the visible party set', 'false',
        String(!!visParty['1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9']));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('agent assigned-only narrowing on the child tables: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'agent assigned-only narrowing on the child tables', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

    function choices(table, element) {

        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('assigned agent can read the case', gr.get('174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd'));
    chk('assigned agent may NOT write assigned_group', 'false', String(gr.getElement('assigned_group').canWrite()));
    chkTrue('assigned agent MAY write assigned_agent', gr.getElement('assigned_agent').canWrite());
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('assigned agent field-level write capability: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'assigned agent field-level write capability', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_agent create, ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write, no delete">afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=7e7bb08d9a54519d78f1d5f0e3f39771"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>7e7bb08d9a54519d78f1d5f0e3f39771</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>8898b672f6b1fa705fab1e7a086680b5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>7e7bb08d9a54519d78f1d5f0e3f39771</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>8b60134d662913e0711a29c54fa68b74</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "agent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "42467a299b31d305bf03d85cf5882b9b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to the agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad0ebc37a39bcca71d91cf84d09d6243",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 group assignment only",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "nobody",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to nobody",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>An In Progress case assigned to the demo agent</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>ce1fc6a45238b1cc99760f242239c480</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_ce1fc6a45238b1cc99760f242239c480</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 10 - In Progress to Pending sets pending_reason, Pending to In Progress clears it">b6cc513ef49eb5be8f42f752cfaf960b</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=ce1fc6a45238b1cc99760f242239c480"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>ce1fc6a45238b1cc99760f242239c480</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>0334d1d7a1b77cab880399c3e5723225</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "0e87e901adab05218fcbf7d5a84bc2c2",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-10",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-10 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

Field-level ACLs on assigned_group and assigned_agent">3fd9e4a1d92dad9b1aed0b58ca382bb5</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=3ea6dc7c283e34856508ed8589ff3d90"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>3ea6dc7c283e34856508ed8589ff3d90</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>58e03edd62bc528e2764541cc5518c5c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>3ea6dc7c283e34856508ed8589ff3d90</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>edc3f593e6ec7d5d2d948a71fc5a91ec</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('viewer can read the case', gr.get('174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd'));
    chk('viewer may NOT write assigned_group', 'false', String(gr.getElement('assigned_group').canWrite()));
    chk('viewer may NOT write assigned_agent', 'false', String(gr.getElement('assigned_agent').canWrite()));
    chkTrue('viewer MAY read assigned_group', gr.getElement('assigned_group').canRead());
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('viewer field-level write capability: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'viewer field-level write capability', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

nothing is created outside the ATF transaction any more</notes><order>10</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>6d6dc143abdd34d4073bf18706ea49c5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_6d6dc143abdd34d4073bf18706ea49c5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 18 - Portal contract: anonymous submit returns 201 with the new case number">a4fab153ebcda77e4c2d7b8905f7d19e</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=6d6dc143abdd34d4073bf18706ea49c5"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>6d6dc143abdd34d4073bf18706ea49c5</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>c1e0c81bb38f030e690bcc9687bbb630</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>6d6dc143abdd34d4073bf18706ea49c5</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>d8c096f06d23c4d82533e736dc685721</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED - AND THERE IS NO LONGER AN EXCEPTION.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology that passed even if every delete had
    // failed. What follows checks the outcome of each delete and then re-queries.
    //
    // It also used to carry a disclosed exception: step 9 submitted a real case
    // anonymously with sn_ws.RESTMessageV2, and an outbound call made from a script
    // is NOT ATF-instrumented, so that row - inserted by `guest`, over HTTP, in its
    // own transaction - sat OUTSIDE the transaction ATF wraps this test in. The
    // deletes below run INSIDE that transaction, so the ATF rollback reversed them
    // and the guest-created row reappeared after every run.
    //
    // Step 9 no longer submits anonymously; it proves the same anonymous perimeter
    // without persisting anything. The ONLY row this test now creates is the one
    // step 2 submits through the ATF-instrumented Send REST Request - Inbound step.
    // That request is itself served as `guest` - it carries no credentials, and its
    // response carries X-Is-Logged-In: false - but ATF instruments the step, so the
    // insert IS inside the rollback context. Measured on 2026-08-08: a run whose
    // step 10 was skipped by an earlier failure still came back clean, the Rollback
    // batch having removed the submitted case on its own. Deleting it here takes
    // effect, and the rollback then nets that insert and this delete to nothing.
    // Creator identity is therefore NOT a residue signal any more - both the old
    // leaked row and today's rolled-back row are guest-owned - so what is reported
    // below is who created each row, and what is asserted is the outcome:
    //   1. every delete this step issues reports success; and
    //   2. a re-query immediately afterwards finds zero rows.
    //
    // One historical caveat, stated rather than hidden: a row left on the instance
    // by a run of the PREVIOUS design is deleted by step 1, and the rollback - which
    // reverses deletions of rows that pre-dated the test - reinstates it. Such rows
    // must be swept once, by hand; runs of this design leave none.
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', 'ATF-PORTAL-18');
    gr.query();
    var n = 0, failedDeletes = [], deletedIds = [];
    while (gr.next()) {
        var rowId = gr.getUniqueValue();
        var createdBy = String(gr.getValue('sys_created_by'));
        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        if (gr.deleteRecord())
            { n++; deletedIds.push(rowId + ' [' + gr.getValue('number') + '] created by ' + createdBy); }
        else failedDeletes.push(rowId);
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    var residue = [];
    var after = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    after.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', 'ATF-PORTAL-18');
    after.query();
    while (after.next())
        residue.push(after.getUniqueValue() + ' [' + after.getValue('subject') + ']');
    chk('no ATF-PORTAL-18 row survives this test', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported line is
    // accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('submissions removed=' + n +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('removed=' + (deletedIds.join(' ; ') || 'none'));
    notes.push('remove the submitted case: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'remove the submitted case', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>
