sys_update_xml.name: sys_atf_test_07f1427f80169c8644b47ead9d5c1b78
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>Form-level companion to ATF 14 for the verbatim message "Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified.". Runs in the ATF client test runner: the case form is opened for a Closed fixture and the Status field is asserted READ-ONLY - the form-level expression of the terminal state, because the application freezes a Closed case so Status cannot be set at all. An earlier shape of this test tried Set Field Values then Submit a Form and could not run: ATF returned "Unable to set field 'status' to value 'In Progress'. Field 'status' is not editable", the application enforcing the terminal state more strictly than that technique assumed. AUTOMATED COVERAGE: step 4 proves the form offers no way out of the terminal state, step 5 proves the stored row is still Closed, and step 6 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. ATF has no step type that can read the classic form error banner - its only text-on-page assertion is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM rather than the platform form this test drives; and because Status is read-only here the form never reaches a submit, so this test produces no banner of its own to read. The read-only control itself IS visible in the runner step-4 screenshot (labelled "Read only - cannot be modified"), and the rendered wording remains a MANUAL observation per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md. Neither is counted as automated coverage anywhere.</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error><name>ATF 17 - Form: a Closed case cannot be moved out of the terminal state on the form</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>07f1427f80169c8644b47ead9d5c1b78</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ATF 17 - Form: a Closed case cannot be moved out of the terminal state on the form</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_07f1427f80169c8644b47ead9d5c1b78</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 08:26:20</sys_updated_on><test_origin>manual</test_origin></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=07f1427f80169c8644b47ead9d5c1b78"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_atf_test_e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>The agent row of the ACL matrix on the child tables (AAP 0.5.6): an agent may read and write a task or party whose PARENT case is assigned to that agent, may create, and may never delete. "Assigned only" is a disjunction - assigned_agent = current user OR assigned_group contains current user - so five parent fixtures isolate it: both branches at once, direct-only, group-only, unassigned, and a group the agent is not a member of. Each parent carries one task and one party child, and every child is asserted for read, write and delete, so neither OR branch can pass on the strength of the other and a fail-open ACL cannot hide. This test previously ran RED because the four scripted child-table ACLs dereferenced the reserved word "case" as current.case, which the script engine refuses to compile ("missing name after . operator"), denying every row; those ACLs now read the parent through current.getElement('case') and the test is green.</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error><name>ATF 07 - RBAC: agent ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write on task and party (AAP 0.5.6 mirror)</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ATF 07 - RBAC: agent ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write on task and party (AAP 0.5.6 mirror)</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><test_origin>manual</test_origin></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d"/></record_update>

falseCOUNTfalsefalsefalsemediumfalsefalseManager View dashboard single-score widget computing COUNT(*) over x_casemgmt_case records whose opened_date falls within the trailing 30-day window. The 30-day cutoff is resolved at query-execution time via javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(30), which returns midnight of the day exactly 30 days before "now" in the system timezone - a rolling window stable across calendar time and portable across PDIs. Single scalar result, on-demand evaluation. No external BI engine; uses native GlideAggregate. <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Three synthetic cases: agent-assigned, group-assigned, and unassigned</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>2f639a629a79c983cd00391c9d368757</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_2f639a629a79c983cd00391c9d368757</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 03 - RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_agent create, ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write, no delete">afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=2f639a629a79c983cd00391c9d368757"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>2f639a629a79c983cd00391c9d368757</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>1a1edfbe06ca793bccb1510fd08f314a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "agent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "42467a299b31d305bf03d85cf5882b9b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to the agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad0ebc37a39bcca71d91cf84d09d6243",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 group assignment only",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "nobody",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-03",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-03 assigned to nobody",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

Resolved to Closed requires the manager role and auto-sets closed_date">60af3ed556ef6085dd5cb0b343ec1888</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=8e1e7d049a34ac7e15b83aff153f2124"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>8e1e7d049a34ac7e15b83aff153f2124</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>301689b4e4d5363d6c7eea2d7b5fa221</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>8e1e7d049a34ac7e15b83aff153f2124</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>c21390682c090c1091cd0a1a42334105</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('the session really is the agent', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    chk('agent does not hold x_casemgmt_case_manager', 'false', String(gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager')));
    var asAgent = v.canTransitionToClosed(gr, AGT_ID);
    chk('canTransitionToClosed refused for the agent', 'false', String(asAgent.ok));
    chkTrue('a blocking message is supplied', String(asAgent.error || '').length > 0);
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('agent message: [' + asAgent.error + ']');
    notes.push('validator refuses a non-manager: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'validator refuses a non-manager', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Every target status yields the AAP 0.7.4 terminal-state wording character for character</notes><order>8</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9f4287fcd61eac9075bf4463ee240ce3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_9f4287fcd61eac9075bf4463ee240ce3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 14 - Prohibited transition: Closed is terminal">6fd42dceb3548cbb6e6535bd1df8c411</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=9f4287fcd61eac9075bf4463ee240ce3"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9f4287fcd61eac9075bf4463ee240ce3</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>82e77275dda42d85ef3635cf271830af</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var TO = ['Draft', 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Pending', 'Resolved'];
    for (var i = 0; i < TO.length; i++) {
        var verdict = v.validateNoBacktransition('Closed', TO[i]);
        chk('Closed to ' + TO[i] + ' refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
        chk('Closed to ' + TO[i] + ' message is verbatim', 'Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified.', String(verdict.error));
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('verbatim terminal-state message for every target status: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'verbatim terminal-state message for every target status', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9f4287fcd61eac9075bf4463ee240ce3</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>996cb1216e304938edf64eb1ed31c8ae</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var FROM = ['Open', 'In Progress', 'Pending', 'Resolved'];
    for (var i = 0; i < FROM.length; i++) {
        var verdict = v.validateNoBacktransition(FROM[i], 'Draft');
        chk(FROM[i] + ' to Draft refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
        chk(FROM[i] + ' to Draft message is verbatim', 'Cases cannot be returned to Draft.', String(verdict.error));
    }
    chkTrue('Draft to Open is not treated as a backtransition', v.validateNoBacktransition('Draft','Open').ok);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('verbatim no-backtransition message from every source status: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'verbatim no-backtransition message from every source status', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

falseCOUNTfalsefalsefalsemediumfalsefalseManager View dashboard donut/pie widget data source. Aggregates ALL records in x_casemgmt_case grouped by the type Choice field with COUNT(*) per bucket. Two slices expected (General Inquiry, Complaint) when seed data spans both case types; the type field is extensible per AAP Section 0.5.7 so future Choice additions automatically appear as new slices without report modification. UNFILTERED by design - shows the entire team caseload split between the two case-handling pipelines (one Flow Designer flow per case type), enabling managers to assess subdomain volume balance and pipeline-staffing needs. Replaces ArkCase's CaseFile.caseType + Pentaho aggregation pipeline with a native GlideAggregate-backed sys_report. sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_298a77ab4eb05c0158ed129ab9d45415
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_casemgmt_case</collection><condition/><description>Display rule on x_casemgmt_case (QA Issue 17, field-value half): publishes the STORED status of the row being displayed onto g_scratchpad.x_casemgmt_stored_status so the onLoad client script ../client_scripts/x_casemgmt_case_closed_readonly_enforce.xml can put the form back in step with the database after an aborted submit. The platform re-renders an aborted save with the POSTED values, so pressing Update on an Open case with status set to Draft leaves the form showing Draft - correctly refused with the verbatim "Cases cannot be returned to Draft.", nothing persisted, sys_mod_count unchanged - while the database still holds Open. The stored value is obtained by re-reading the row from the database by its own sys_id with a fresh GlideRecord, the same technique CaseTransitionValidator._storedRecord() uses, and never by reading a status off current: it is not established whether a display rule receives the stored or the posted record on an abort re-render, and this rule is correct either way. Fail-safe: the empty string is published first and remains published on every abnormal path (no g_scratchpad, a new record with no sys_id, a row that cannot be re-read because it was deleted or the read ACLs deny it, or any exception), and the client treats the empty string as "nothing to correct". Read-only by construction - when=display with all four action_* flags false - so enforcement stays entirely in the before-update rules and the shared Script Include. Writes no record, changes no field and calls no message API, because the blocking banner from the aborted save must survive per AAP Sections 0.5.5 and 0.7.1. Per AAP Sections 0.5.5, 0.7.1 and 0.7.2.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state</name><order>10</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Publish the STORED status of this case onto the scratchpad so the
    // onLoad client script can correct a form that the platform
    // re-rendered with POSTED values after an aborted save.
    //
    // QA Issue 17 (field-value half): on an Open case, setting Status to
    // Draft and pressing Update is refused by
    // x_casemgmt_block_draft_backtransition with the verbatim "Cases
    // cannot be returned to Draft." and nothing is persisted - yet the
    // form that comes back still shows Draft until the user reloads.
    //
    // THE ONE THING TO KNOW WHEN READING THIS: it is NOT established
    // whether, on that abort re-render, a display Business Rule is handed
    // the STORED row or the POSTED one in `current`. Nothing below
    // depends on the answer, because nothing below reads a status off
    // `current`. The status is re-read from the database by primary key
    // with a fresh GlideRecord - the same technique
    // x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator._storedRecord() uses for the
    // transition buttons - so the value published here is the stored one
    // either way. If `current` was the posted record the client finds a
    // divergence and corrects the field; if it was already the stored
    // record the two values agree and the client does nothing.
    //
    // FAIL SAFE: every abnormal path leaves the empty string published,
    // which the client reads as "nothing to correct" and acts on by doing
    // nothing at all. This rule can therefore never change what a form
    // shows unless it can demonstrate, against a fresh database read,
    // that the form and the database disagree.
    //
    // IT MUST NOT, AND DOES NOT, TOUCH THE MESSAGE AREA. AAP Section
    // 0.5.5 requires the blocking error to be surfaced on the form, so
    // the banner the aborted save wrote has to survive the correction.
    // No message API is called here or in the client half.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // Outside a form render there is no scratchpad to publish onto. This
    // rule is when=display so that should not happen, but referencing an
    // absent global would throw during a form render, which is the one
    // thing a display rule must never do.
    if (typeof g_scratchpad === 'undefined' || !g_scratchpad) {
        return;
    }

    // Published FIRST, and left in place by every path below that cannot
    // prove a stored value. Writing it up front means no failure after
    // this line can leave the client acting on a value from an earlier
    // render.
    g_scratchpad.x_casemgmt_stored_status = '';

    if (!current) {
        return;
    }

    // A record with no sys_id has never been written: there is no stored
    // row to describe, and the values on screen are the only description
    // of it that exists. Same reasoning as the new-record fallback in
    // CaseTransitionValidator._storedRecord().
    var sysId = '';
    try {
        sysId = current.getUniqueValue();
        sysId = (sysId === null || sysId === undefined) ? '' : String(sysId).trim();
    } catch (idError) {
        // getUniqueValue() is defined on every GlideRecord; this branch
        // exists so that this rule can never be the reason a form fails
        // to render.
        gs.warn('x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state: could not read the sys_id of the record being' +
                ' displayed (' + idError + '). No stored status was published, so the form is left' +
                ' exactly as the platform rendered it.');
        return;
    }
    if (sysId === '') {
        return;
    }

    try {
        var stored = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
        if (!stored.get(sysId)) {
            // The row is gone, or the running user may not read it -
            // scoped GlideRecord applies the read ACLs in ../acl/, so
            // for an x_casemgmt_case_agent this is precisely the
            // unassigned case they are refused everywhere else. Either
            // way there is no stored value to publish and the form is
            // left untouched.
            gs.warn('x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state: the stored row for case ' + sysId +
                    ' could not be re-read (deleted, or not readable by the current user). No stored' +
                    ' status was published.');
            return;
        }

        var storedStatus = stored.getValue('status');
        storedStatus = (storedStatus === null || storedStatus === undefined) ? '' : String(storedStatus).trim();

        // The status Choice values are Title Case and identical to their
        // labels (../choices/sys_choice_case_status.xml), so this string
        // is exactly what g_form.setValue('status', ...) needs on the
        // client - no display value, no translation.
        g_scratchpad.x_casemgmt_stored_status = storedStatus;
    } catch (readError) {
        // Monitoring hook. The empty string published above stands, so
        // the client does nothing and the form renders as the platform
        // built it.
        g_scratchpad.x_casemgmt_stored_status = '';
        gs.warn('x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state: the stored status of case ' + sysId +
                ' could not be resolved (' + readError + '). No stored status was published, so the' +
                ' form is left exactly as the platform rendered it.');
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>298a77ab4eb05c0158ed129ab9d45415</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_x_casemgmt_case_display_stored_state</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before_display</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=298a77ab4eb05c0158ed129ab9d45415"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
x_casemgmt_case_resolvetruefalseUI Action that transitions an In Progress case to Resolved status. Visible to x_casemgmt_case_manager (always) and x_casemgmt_case_agent (only when they are assigned to the case via assigned_agent or member of assigned_group, per AAP Section 0.5.6 Assigned-only rule). Delegates the all-tasks-closed check to x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator.canTransitionToResolved() (single source of truth shared with ../flows/sub_flows/validate_resolved_transition.xml). Per AAP Section 0.5.5 row 5 verbatim: "In Progress -> Resolved: All linked x_casemgmt_case_task records have status = Closed - Surface 'All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.'". Surfaces verbatim error message "All tasks must be closed before resolving this case." (per AAP Sections 0.5.5 and 0.7.4) when any child task has status != Closed. Server-side-only (no client prompt) - the transition has no required parameters beyond the existing child task rows on the case. Performs the transition on the server with defense-in-depth re-validation of role, status, and "Assigned only" assignment. Surfaces a form-level blocking error via gs.addErrorMessage if any guard fails (verbatim message returned by the Script Include). Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint, zero hardcoded sys_id literals, and zero PII.new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator().canShowAction(current, 'In Progress')truetruefalsefalsefalsefalseprimaryfalseResolve this case (all child tasks must be Closed).truefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalseResolve500falsefalsefalsetruesys_ui_actionsystem2025-01-01 00:00:00global/fcef26b5dd69234a0b4a8ea82d997b170x_casemgmt_case_resolve82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5afsys_ui_action_x_casemgmt_case_resolvesystem2025-01-01 00:00:00x_casemgmt_case

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_7c4b1ea2938f74320d74d6f88357a5c1
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_casemgmt_case</collection><condition/><description>Before-insert/update on x_casemgmt_case: refuses any write whose subject exceeds 255 characters, description exceeds 4000, requester_name exceeds 100 or requester_email exceeds 100 - the four max_length values declared in AAP Section 0.5.7 and in the dictionary entries under ../dictionary/. Every offending field is named in its own gs.addErrorMessage() ('<label> must be <limit> characters or fewer. The value supplied is <n> characters.') and the write is cancelled with current.setAbortAction(true), so an over-length value can never be persisted by ANY write path. This closes a silent-data-loss gap: the platform enforces max_length only as an HTML maxlength attribute on forms - absent altogether on the >255-character description textarea, which accepted 4100 characters - and then cuts the value to fit at storage while reporting the save as successful, so the end of a long description was lost with nothing said to its author. Coverage measured on this instance: description is TEXT-backed and is ENFORCED here (a 4001-character description is answered HTTP 403 with the stored value unchanged; 4000 is accepted), while subject, requester_name and requester_email are VARCHAR-backed and are coerced to fit by the platform BEFORE the before rules run (a 300-character subject is answered HTTP 200 and stored at 255), so their checks below are the correct invariant but cannot fire from a coerced write; those three are bounded instead by the form's rendered maxlength attribute and by the anonymous portal endpoint's HTTP 400, and raising their declared max_length to make the value observable is prohibited by AAP Sections 0.5.7 and 0.7.1. A form-layer control cannot close this, because the Table API, import sets, fix scripts and flows write this table without rendering any attribute; a before rule is the only layer that covers every path. Order=70 places this rule FIRST in the before-rule chain, ahead of block_terminal_closed (100), set_opened_date (100), block_draft_backtransition (200), enforce_forward_transitions (250), validate_assigned_agent_membership (300), clear_pending_reason_on_inprogress (400) and set_closed_date (500), because a length violation is a property of the value and is independent of any status transition; orders 50 and 80 are reserved for sibling guards. Dual-triggered (action_insert AND action_update) because both paths can carry an over-length value. Early-returns on current.isActionAborted() so it never stacks a message on a save another rule already refused. Says nothing about empty values - the mandatory concern belongs to a separate guard. The anonymous portal path is additionally guarded, earlier and with an HTTP 400 { error, fields } body, by x_casemgmt.CasePortalService._validateSubmission(); this rule is the guarantee that holds when that path is not the writer. Type-agnostic: fires for both General Inquiry and Complaint. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint and zero hardcoded sys_id literals.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>x_casemgmt_validate_case_text_lengths</name><order>70</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    // Per AAP Section 0.5.7 (x_casemgmt_case schema), these four fields
    // carry a declared maximum length:
    //
    //     | Field           | Type         | Constraint |
    //     | subject         | String(255)  | Mandatory  |
    //     | description     | String(4000) | Mandatory  |
    //     | requester_name  | String(100)  | Mandatory  |
    //     | requester_email | String(100)  | Optional   |
    //
    // The declaration lives in the dictionary entries under
    // ../dictionary/, and the platform honours it as an HTML maxlength
    // attribute on forms and as a cut-to-fit at storage. Neither is a
    // refusal: the form drops keystrokes past the limit without a counter
    // or a notice, the >255-character description textarea is rendered
    // with no maxlength attribute at all, and the write itself succeeds
    // with the tail of the value missing. This rule is the refusal, and
    // it is placed in the before chain so it covers every write path -
    // form, Table API, import set, fix script and flow alike.
    //
    // WHAT THIS RULE CAN OBSERVE. The platform coerces an over-length
    // value for a VARCHAR-backed column (declared length 255 or fewer)
    // BEFORE the before rules run, so subject, requester_name and
    // requester_email arrive here already cut to fit and their original
    // length is unrecoverable in script. Measured on this instance: a
    // PATCH sending a 300-character subject answered HTTP 200 and stored
    // 255, while a PATCH sending a 4001-character description was aborted
    // by this rule with the stored value unchanged. description is
    // TEXT-backed - the platform does not coerce it - which is why the
    // check below is the effective guard for exactly the field that had
    // no client-side maxlength and the most to lose. The other three
    // checks are the correct invariant and are kept for the case where a
    // write path delivers an uncoerced value, but they are not what
    // bounds those fields today: the form's maxlength attribute and the
    // portal endpoint's HTTP 400 do. See the file header for the full
    // measurement and for why raising the declared max_length to make the
    // value observable is prohibited by AAP Sections 0.5.7 and 0.7.1.
    //
    // The single source of truth for the limits is the table below. It
    // is authored here rather than read from sys_dictionary at runtime on
    // purpose: a sys_dictionary lookup would add four queries to every
    // insert and update of this table to re-learn four constants that the
    // AAP fixes, and a rule that derived its own limits from the schema
    // could be silently relaxed by an unrelated dictionary edit. The
    // labels match the dictionary column_labels so the message a user
    // reads names the field the way the form does.

    var LENGTH_LIMITS = [
        { name: 'subject',         label: 'Subject',         maxLength: 255 },
        { name: 'description',     label: 'Description',     maxLength: 4000 },
        { name: 'requester_name',  label: 'Requester Name',  maxLength: 100 },
        { name: 'requester_email', label: 'Requester Email', maxLength: 100 }
    ];

    // Skip if an earlier rule in the chain has already rejected this save.
    // setAbortAction(true) cancels the WRITE, not the rule chain - the
    // platform runs every remaining before rule and exposes the pending
    // abort through current.isActionAborted(). Returning here keeps a
    // save that a sibling guard already refused from also collecting
    // length messages, so the user reads the one message that explains
    // the refusal. This rule runs at order 70, so the flag is normally
    // false when it is read; the guard exists for the case where an
    // order-50 sibling has already refused the save.
    if (current.isActionAborted()) {
        return;
    }

    // Collect EVERY violation before deciding, so a save carrying two
    // over-length fields reports both. Stopping at the first would turn
    // correcting the record into a series of rejected saves, each
    // revealing one more problem.
    var violations = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < LENGTH_LIMITS.length; i++) {
        var spec = LENGTH_LIMITS[i];

        // getValue() is used rather than current[spec.name] because the
        // property form returns a GlideElement wrapper, and reading
        // .length on the wrapper yields undefined rather than the
        // character count - a comparison that would silently never fire.
        // getValue() returns the underlying string (or null), and the
        // String() coercion makes .length meaningful for both. An empty
        // or null column becomes '' (length 0) and therefore passes -
        // emptiness is the mandatory guard's concern, not this rule's.
        var value = String(current.getValue(spec.name) || '');

        if (value.length > spec.maxLength) {
            violations.push({
                label: spec.label,
                maxLength: spec.maxLength,
                actual: value.length
            });
        }
    }

    if (violations.length === 0) {
        // Nothing to say. The rule mutates no field and adds no message
        // on the normal path, so it is invisible to every write that
        // respects the declared lengths - which is every write the
        // application makes today: the longest values among the seeded
        // rows are a 69-character subject, a 106-character description,
        // a 25-character requester_name and a 28-character
        // requester_email.
        return;
    }

    for (var v = 0; v < violations.length; v++) {
        var violation = violations[v];

        // gs.addErrorMessage() surfaces the message at the top of the
        // case form when the write arrives through the UI, and the
        // platform reports the abort to a Table API caller as an HTTP
        // 403 naming the rule that refused it. Per AAP Section 0.7.1:
        // "Surface all blocking errors on the form. Invalid transition
        // attempts MUST produce a blocking error message visible on the
        // form - silent failures or post-save error logs are
        // unacceptable." A silently shortened value is the same class of
        // defect as a silent failure: the write reports success and the
        // data is not what was written.
        //
        // Per AAP Section 0.7.4 only four messages are verbatim and
        // non-negotiable ("All tasks must be closed before resolving
        // this case.", "Cases cannot be returned to Draft.", "Closed
        // cases are terminal and cannot be modified.", "No case found
        // with that number."). This message is NOT one of them, so the
        // wording is target-side authored; it names the field with the
        // dictionary's own label, quotes the declared limit, and quotes
        // the length received so the value can be fixed in one edit.
        gs.addErrorMessage(violation.label + ' must be ' + violation.maxLength +
            ' characters or fewer. The value supplied is ' + violation.actual +
            ' characters.');
    }

    // current.setAbortAction(true) cancels the database write. Both calls
    // are required and neither substitutes for the other: without the
    // messages the write would be refused with nothing to read, and
    // without the abort the messages would appear while the row was
    // written with the value cut to fit - which is precisely the
    // behaviour this rule exists to end.
    current.setAbortAction(true);

    // A refused write is worth a server-side trace: an integration whose
    // payloads are being refused needs a record of it that does not
    // depend on someone watching a form. The log names the fields and the
    // lengths, never the values, so no case content or requester detail
    // reaches the system log. current.number is empty on insert (the
    // number is generated after the before rules run), so the fallback
    // keeps the line readable for the insert case.
    var refusedFields = [];
    for (var w = 0; w < violations.length; w++) {
        refusedFields.push(violations[w].label + '=' + violations[w].actual +
            '/' + violations[w].maxLength);
    }
    gs.warn('x_casemgmt_validate_case_text_lengths: write refused on ' +
        (current.getValue('number') || 'a new case') +
        ' - over-length field(s): ' + refusedFields.join(', '));
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7c4b1ea2938f74320d74d6f88357a5c1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_casemgmt_validate_case_text_lengths</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_x_casemgmt_validate_case_text_lengths</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=7c4b1ea2938f74320d74d6f88357a5c1"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_security_acl"><sys_security_acl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><admin_overrides>true</admin_overrides><advanced>false</advanced><applies_to/><condition/><controlled_by_refs/><decision_type>allow</decision_type><description>Field-level ACL granting the query_range operation on x_casemgmt_case_task.due_date to x_casemgmt_case_manager, x_casemgmt_case_agent and x_casemgmt_case_viewer. Authored for QA finding F17, which reported every range predicate on this column (>, <, BETWEEN, 'at or after', 'last 30 days') being dropped from the query for non-admin callers - 0 rows plus a server ACL banner naming the query_range operation inside an HTTP 200 list page, and HTTP 403 'Insufficient rights to query records' over the Table API. Retained as an explicit scoped grant rather than a proven repair: re-verification could not reproduce the refusal, and a differential probe measured no difference against columns carrying no such ACL, so this record makes the range filtering implied by AAP Section 0.5.6 'Read - All' independent of the instance's default query_range posture. query_range shapes the query only; which rows are returned remains governed by each role's read ACL, so the agent still sees just its assigned set.</description><local_or_existing>Existing</local_or_existing><name>x_casemgmt_case_task.due_date</name><operation display_value="query_range">e66cf897b7300210240b06dd1e11a9fd</operation><script/><security_attribute/><sys_class_name>sys_security_acl</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-10 00:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>bade7e7294de81bda174f70df76d94ff</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_casemgmt_case_task.due_date</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_security_acl_bade7e7294de81bda174f70df76d94ff</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 03:30:24</sys_updated_on><type display_value="record">record</type></sys_security_acl></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
trueparty_type=OrganizationPolymorphic field-rendering UI Policy on x_casemgmt_case_party for the Organization branch of the party_type discriminator. Companion to "Case Party Conditional Fields - Person" and the ServiceNow-native equivalent of ArkCase's dual-table @ManyToOne pattern from PersonOrganizationAssociation.java per AAP Section 0.4.3. When party_type=Organization the single sys_ui_policy_action child makes the organization reference field visible and mandatory; because reverse_if_false=true, any other party_type value - including empty - reverses that action so organization becomes hidden and not mandatory. This policy deliberately acts on the organization field ONLY, which is why the empty-party_type state is deterministic: both policies reverse, and each reverses its own single field. Declarative actions plus reverse_if_false give the platform a watched field (party_type, taken from the condition) so the state is re-evaluated on every change, not only at form load; on_load=true additionally applies the correct state when an existing party record is opened. run_scripts is false and both script bodies are empty. cleared=false on the action so toggling party_type never destroys a value the user already entered. The organization field is nullable at the dictionary level (../dictionary/x_casemgmt_case_party_organization.xml) precisely so that its required-ness can be conditional here.truefalsefalsetrue110truefalseCase Party Conditional Fields - Organization: show organization and make it mandatory when party_type=Organization; reverse (hide, not mandatory) for every other value including empty.sys_ui_policysystem2025-01-01 00:00:00global/507da6cb683691d5a09285ab09297b220Case Party Conditional Fields - Organization: show organization and make it mandatory when party_type=Organization; reverse (hide, not mandatory) for every other value including empty.82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5afsys_ui_policy_507da6cb683691d5a09285ab09297b22system2025-01-01 00:00:00x_casemgmt_case_party

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json</consumes><consumes_customized>true</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Case Status Lookup GET</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    // Per AAP Section 0.4.4 + Section 0.7.4 (Other User-Provided Rules):
    // Anonymous case-status-lookup endpoint. The whitelisted-field discipline
    // (response contains ONLY status, subject, opened_date) lives in the
    // Script Include x_casemgmt.CasePortalService.lookupCase(). This handler
    // is intentionally thin: only HTTP-layer concerns (status codes, body
    // shapes, query-parameter extraction) live here.
    //
    // Per AAP Section 0.7.4 (verbatim, non-negotiable): when the case number
    // does NOT match, return HTTP 404 with the verbatim body
    //   { error: 'No case found with that number.' }
    // The EXACT text (capital N, lowercase elsewhere, trailing period,
    // ASCII straight single quotes) is mandated by AAP Sections 0.4.4 and
    // 0.7.4. The lookup widget displays this text verbatim.

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Extract the 'number' query parameter defensively.
    //
    //    request.queryParams may be undefined (no query string supplied).
    //    request.queryParams.number may be undefined (parameter absent),
    //    a String (single value supplied), or an Array (when the URL has
    //    duplicate parameter names, e.g. ?number=A&number=B - the platform
    //    typically deduplicates but defensive code handles both shapes).
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    var caseNumber = '';
    if (request.queryParams && request.queryParams.number) {
        var raw = request.queryParams.number;
        if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
            // URL had ?number=A&number=B (rare). Take the first value.
            // Returning an error ("multiple values supplied") would leak
            // information about the API's parameter shape; instead,
            // silently honor the first value to maintain the simple
            // 200/404 response surface.
            raw = raw.length > 0 ? raw[0] : '';
        }
        // Coerce-to-String defensively (raw may arrive as Number on some
        // platform versions when the query value is numeric-looking) and
        // trim leading/trailing whitespace.
        caseNumber = String(raw || '').trim();
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. An empty or missing parameter is NOT short-circuited here, and that
    //    is deliberate. It still produces the identical verbatim 404 - the
    //    Script Include validates the value and answers null for an empty
    //    one, exactly as it does for a malformed one and for a genuine miss,
    //    so "missing parameter" remains indistinguishable from "case not
    //    found" and the API's parameter shape is still not disclosed.
    //
    //    What changed is that the request now reaches the Script Include's
    //    per-session throttle and abuse monitor instead of being answered
    //    ahead of them (review finding F07). An earlier revision returned
    //    the 404 from right here, which meant a caller could issue unlimited
    //    parameter-less or malformed requests without ever being counted -
    //    free attempts, and an unmonitored path. The Script Include performs
    //    NO query for such a value, so delegating costs nothing.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Delegate to the Script Include. The Script Include is the single
    //    source of truth for:
    //      - The GlideRecord query against x_casemgmt_case
    //      - The field whitelist (returns ONLY status, subject, opened_date)
    //      - The lookup-by-number contract (matches AAP Section 0.7.2's
    //        no-hardcoded-sys_id rule by querying the public 'number' field)
    //
    //    Contract:
    //      - lookupCase(<the raw query-parameter value, possibly empty>)
    //        returns:
    //          * null       - no case matches the supplied number, OR the
    //                         value is not a well-formed case number, OR no
    //                         value was supplied. One outcome, one response.
    //          * { throttled: true }
    //                       - this session is over its per-session request
    //                         ceiling for the trailing window
    //          * { status: String, subject: String, opened_date: String }
    //                       - case found, all values pre-coerced to strings
    //
    //    The Script Include is invoked via the scope-qualified API name
    //    `x_casemgmt.CasePortalService` (NOT by sys_id), which complies
    //    with AAP Section 0.7.2's no-hardcoded-sys_id constraint.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    var svc = new x_casemgmt.CasePortalService();
    var result = svc.lookupCase(caseNumber);

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3a. Session over its lookup ceiling -> HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
    //
    //    The Script Include sets throttled=true when this session has
    //    exceeded the per-session request ceiling for the trailing window
    //    (review finding F07: the anonymous lookup had no throttle at all,
    //    which made a sweep of the sequential case-number space free). 429
    //    is the correct status for the condition and it MIRRORS the submit
    //    endpoint's own 429 branch in
    //    ./sys_ws_operation_x_casemgmt_case_submit_post.xml, so both
    //    anonymous endpoints refuse in the same way.
    //
    //    THIS BRANCH IS CHECKED BEFORE THE NOT-FOUND BRANCH BELOW, and must
    //    stay there: a throttled request learned NOTHING about the case
    //    table, so answering it with the AAP Section 0.7.4 not-found body
    //    would state as fact that the requester's case does not exist. That
    //    is the same reason the lookup widget renders a distinct panel for
    //    it rather than the verbatim not-found text.
    //
    //    The message is hardcoded here, exactly as the not-found text is; it
    //    is never taken from the Script Include's return value, and it
    //    carries no count, ceiling or window - nothing an anonymous caller
    //    could use to calibrate a sweep against the limit.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (result && result.throttled) {
        response.setStatus(429);
        response.setBody({ error: 'Too many lookup requests were received in a short period. Please try again in a minute.' });
        return;
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. No-match -> verbatim 404. Per AAP Section 0.7.4, the literal text
    //    'No case found with that number.' MUST appear in the response.
    //    This is the SAME response shape returned in step 2 for empty/
    //    missing parameters - intentional uniformity prevents anonymous
    //    callers from distinguishing "parameter absent" from "case not found".
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (result === null || result === undefined) {
        response.setStatus(404);
        response.setBody({ error: 'No case found with that number.' });
        return;
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Match -> HTTP 200 with the three whitelisted fields.
    //
    //    The Script Include already coerces to String(...) and applies
    //    `|| ''` defaults; THIS extraction is a defense-in-depth layer
    //    that:
    //      a. Re-coerces in case the Script Include's contract changes
    //         (e.g., a future refactor accidentally returns GlideElement
    //         instances, which would serialize unpredictably).
    //      b. Drops any additional fields the Script Include may return
    //         (defense against accidental field exposure in future edits).
    //      c. Replaces null/undefined with empty string (cleaner JSON
    //         than `null` or the literal text "undefined" for missing
    //         field values).
    //
    //    Response body shape (exactly three keys, no others):
    //      {
    //        status:      "<value or empty string>",
    //        subject:     "<value or empty string>",
    //        opened_date: "<value or empty string>"
    //      }
    //
    //    Internal fields that MUST NOT appear in this response (per AAP
    //    Section 0.4.4):
    //      assigned_group, assigned_agent, description, closed_date,
    //      requester_name, requester_email, priority, type, pending_reason,
    //      sys_id, sys_created_by, sys_created_on, sys_updated_by,
    //      sys_updated_on, sys_mod_count, sys_class_name, sys_domain.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    response.setStatus(200);
    response.setBody({
        status:      String(result.status      || ''),
        subject:     String(result.subject     || ''),
        opened_date: String(result.opened_date || '')
    });
})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>false</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Anonymous case status GET: 200 fields, 404 verbatim not-found, 429 throttled</short_description><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-30 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>f3b3b39ceb9115bf7bf40e3eaf042b4f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Case Status Lookup GET</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_x_casemgmt_case_status_lookup_get</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-30 12:00:00</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Case Status Lookup">b04176032af365e6b8770ba3e6089b58</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
