sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_casemgmt_case</collection><condition/><description>Before-update guard on x_casemgmt_case that enforces the forward-transition preconditions of the case state machine. On a status change it invokes the matching natively authored Flow Designer subflow (x_casemgmt.validate_open_transition, validate_in_progress_transition, validate_pending_transition, validate_resolved_transition, validate_closed_transition) synchronously with sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().inForeground(), then re-evaluates the same gate against the in-flight record through x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator and, on failure, calls gs.addErrorMessage() with the verbatim blocking message plus current.setAbortAction(true) so the error surfaces on the form. Order 250 runs after the Closed-terminal (100) and Any-to-Draft (200) prohibition guards and before the side-effect rules (300/400/500). FAIL-CLOSED: the six canonical statuses are an explicit allowlist - Draft passes to the order-200 rule that owns it, the other five are gated here, and any other value (a stale choice, a direct Table API or scripted write such as Approved) is refused with a blocking message and setAbortAction(true) rather than skipping every gate; and validator construction, guard dispatch and verdict-shape validation all run inside one try/catch, so an exception, a malformed verdict, a non-boolean ok or a rejection with no message produces an explicit deny with a sanitized server diagnostic and a generic user message instead of relying on platform exception semantics.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions</name><order>250</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Guard against the INSERT path. `previous` is null on insert, and a
    // brand-new case has no prior status, so there is no forward
    // transition to validate. Portal submissions insert with
    // status = Draft and must never be blocked here.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (!previous) {
        return;
    }

    var previousStatus = String(previous.status);
    var proposedStatus = String(current.status);

    // Only a genuine status change is a transition. Field-only updates
    // (subject, description, priority, assignment) are not this rule's
    // concern and are left to the other before-update rules.
    if (previousStatus === proposedStatus) {
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Stop if an earlier rule in the chain has already rejected this save.
    //
    // setAbortAction(true) cancels the WRITE, not the remaining before-update
    // rules - the platform keeps running them and reports the pending abort
    // through current.isActionAborted(). Order 100
    // (x_casemgmt_block_terminal_closed, Closed -> *) and order 200
    // (x_casemgmt_block_draft_backtransition, Any -> Draft) both run first and
    // both abort with their own verbatim message. Returning here means an
    // already-rejected transition does not pay the 8-10 second synchronous
    // subflow execution below, and does not collect a second diagnosis for a
    // save that will never be persisted.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (current.isActionAborted()) {
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Map the proposed status onto the Flow Designer subflow that owns
    // its precondition. The subflow internal names are the natively
    // authored subflows in this scope; each one runs the shared
    // `Case Transition Guard` Custom Action, which delegates to
    // x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator so there is a single source of
    // truth for the transition rules and their verbatim messages.
    //
    // 'Draft' is deliberately absent: the Any -> Draft prohibition is
    // owned by x_casemgmt_block_draft_backtransition (order 200) and the
    // Closed -> * prohibition by x_casemgmt_block_terminal_closed
    // (order 100). Both run before this rule.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var SUBFLOW_FOR_STATUS = {
        'Open': 'validate_open_transition',
        'In Progress': 'validate_in_progress_transition',
        'Pending': 'validate_pending_transition',
        'Resolved': 'validate_resolved_transition',
        'Closed': 'validate_closed_transition'
    };
    var subflowName = SUBFLOW_FOR_STATUS[proposedStatus];
    if (!subflowName) {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
        // ALLOWLIST, NOT A LOOKUP MISS. Reaching here means the proposed
        // status is not one of the five this rule dispatches on. Exactly one
        // value legitimately lands here - 'Draft' - because the Any -> Draft
        // prohibition belongs to x_casemgmt_block_draft_backtransition at
        // order 200, which has already aborted the save with its own verbatim
        // message. Every OTHER value is a status this application does not
        // recognise, and it must NOT be allowed through.
        //
        // Why this matters: a Choice dictionary is not this rule's allowlist,
        // and the two layers protect different paths. MEASURED on this release:
        // `status` carries choice = 3, so the REST Table API silently DROPS an
        // unrecognised value before any rule evaluates - the PATCH answers
        // HTTP 200, the stored value is unchanged and sys_mod_count stays 0, so
        // this branch is never reached from that path (see the register, section
        // 4 item 15). What the branch guards is every OTHER way `status` can
        // hold a value this application does not recognise: a stale choice left
        // behind by a de-activated or renamed sys_choice row, and any write path
        // that does not run dictionary choice validation. Returning without
        // aborting, as an earlier revision did, would let such a value park a
        // case in an unrecognised state with NO assignment check, NO task
        // closure check and NO manager check: every order-250 gate skipped.
        // It costs one map lookup, so it stays even though the common path
        // cannot reach it.
        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
        if (proposedStatus === 'Draft') {
            return;
        }
        // The offending value is recorded server-side, sanitized (newlines
        // stripped, length capped) so a crafted value cannot forge log lines,
        // and is deliberately NOT echoed back to the user.
        var sanitized = proposedStatus.replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, ' ');
        if (sanitized.length > 80) {
            sanitized = sanitized.substring(0, 80) + '...';
        }
        gs.error('x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions: refused a status this application does not' +
                 ' recognise on case ' + String(current.getUniqueValue()) + ' (' + previousStatus +
                 ' -> "' + sanitized + '"). Only Draft, Open, In Progress, Pending, Resolved and Closed' +
                 ' are valid; the write was aborted.');
        gs.addErrorMessage('That is not a valid case status. A case may only be Draft, Open, In Progress, ' +
                           'Pending, Resolved or Closed.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }

    var caseSysId = String(current.getUniqueValue());

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // STEP 0 - validate the transition EDGE, i.e. previous -> proposed.
    //
    // Everything below this point validates the PRECONDITION OF THE
    // TARGET STATUS and nothing else: the subflow and the validator are
    // both selected by `proposedStatus`. That answers "does this case
    // satisfy what Resolved requires" but never "was this case allowed to
    // reach Resolved from where it actually was". Without this step a
    // single save moved a case straight from Draft to Closed: it skipped
    // Open's assigned_group requirement, In Progress's agent-membership
    // requirement and Resolved's task-closure gate, and it landed in the
    // terminal state with closed_date empty, because
    // x_casemgmt_set_closed_date (order 500) keys on the Resolved ->
    // Closed edge. All eight illegal skip/backward edges behaved the
    // same way. AAP Section 0.5.5 is the complete set of legal edges and
    // AAP Section 0.7.3 Gate 2 requires all of them to be enforced.
    //
    // The graph itself lives in x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator so the
    // Business Rule layer, the Flow Designer subflows and the Custom
    // Action all share one definition.
    //
    // ORDER MATTERS, in three ways:
    //   1) AFTER current.isActionAborted() above, so an already-rejected
    //      save is not diagnosed twice.
    //   2) AFTER the SUBFLOW_FOR_STATUS allowlist branch, so an
    //      unrecognised TARGET status keeps its own message ("That is not
    //      a valid case status...") and a proposed Draft keeps being
    //      handled by x_casemgmt_block_draft_backtransition at order 200.
    //   3) BEFORE the synchronous subflow run below, so an illegal edge
    //      is refused in milliseconds instead of paying the several
    //      seconds a foreground subflow costs.
    //
    // Fail CLOSED, exactly as STEP 2 does: this is an authorization-grade
    // gate, so a verdict that cannot be computed or comes back malformed
    // aborts the save rather than falling through to the target-only
    // checks that were the whole defect.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var edgeVerdict;
    try {
        edgeVerdict = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator()
            .validateTransitionEdge(previousStatus, proposedStatus);
        if (!edgeVerdict || typeof edgeVerdict !== 'object' || typeof edgeVerdict.ok !== 'boolean') {
            throw 'the validator returned a malformed edge verdict (' + String(edgeVerdict) + ')';
        }
        if (edgeVerdict.ok === false && (typeof edgeVerdict.error !== 'string' || edgeVerdict.error === '')) {
            throw 'the validator rejected the edge without supplying a message';
        }
    } catch (edgeError) {
        gs.error('x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions: the transition edge could not be evaluated for' +
                 ' case ' + caseSysId + ' (' + previousStatus + ' -> ' + proposedStatus + ') - ' +
                 edgeError + '. The save was aborted: an unevaluated transition is refused, never' +
                 ' allowed.');
        gs.addErrorMessage('This change could not be validated and has not been saved. Please try again, ' +
                           'and tell your administrator if it keeps happening.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }

    if (!edgeVerdict.ok) {
        // The message comes from the Script Include - for the two
        // PROHIBITED rows of the matrix it is the VERBATIM AAP Section
        // 0.7.4 text, and for a skip edge it names both the attempted
        // edge and the legal next status. Never paraphrased here.
        gs.addErrorMessage(edgeVerdict.error);
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // STEP 1 - run the Flow Designer subflow SYNCHRONOUSLY.
    //
    // Flow Designer record triggers (Created / Updated) fire AFTER the
    // database write commits, so a triggered flow can never abort a save
    // or surface a form-level blocking error. Invoking the subflow in the
    // foreground from this before-update rule is what makes the
    // state-machine flows load-bearing at the moment of the transition
    // instead of after it.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var flowBlocked = null;
    try {
        var flowOutputs = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner()
            .subflow('x_casemgmt.' + subflowName)
            .inForeground()
            .withInputs({ case_sys_id: caseSysId })
            .run()
            .getOutputs();
        flowBlocked = (String(flowOutputs['blocked']) === 'true');
    } catch (flowError) {
        // Fail closed onto the validator rather than silently allowing
        // the transition: STEP 2 below still decides the outcome.
        gs.warn('x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions: subflow x_casemgmt.' + subflowName +
                ' could not be executed for case ' + caseSysId + ' - ' + flowError +
                '. Falling back to the in-flight CaseTransitionValidator evaluation.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // STEP 2 - evaluate the same gate against the IN-FLIGHT record.
    //
    // The subflow reads the case from the database, so it sees the
    // committed row. A single save may change `assigned_group` or
    // `assigned_agent` in the same transaction as `status`; in that case
    // the committed row is stale and only `current` reflects what will
    // actually be persisted. This step therefore decides the outcome,
    // using the identical x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator methods the
    // subflow's Custom Action calls, so both paths produce the same
    // verbatim messages. For a status-only save - which is what all six
    // UI Actions and the case form produce - the two verdicts are
    // identical and the subflow's verdict IS the decision.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Everything that decides the outcome is inside this try/catch, because
    // this is the load-bearing authorization step for a direct update and it
    // must fail CLOSED. Constructing the Script Include can throw (a scope
    // resolution failure, a compile error in the include, an upgrade in
    // flight); the guards themselves run GlideRecord and GlideAggregate
    // queries against sys_user_grmember, sys_user_has_role and
    // x_casemgmt_case_task, any of which can throw or time out; and a future
    // edit could return something that is not a verdict at all. Without this
    // wrapper any of those exits before the only explicit
    // current.setAbortAction(true) below, and enforcement would then depend on
    // platform exception semantics rather than on a deny decision this rule
    // actually took.
    var verdict;
    try {
        var validator = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
        if (proposedStatus === 'Open') {
            verdict = validator.canTransitionToOpen(current);
        } else if (proposedStatus === 'In Progress') {
            verdict = validator.canTransitionToInProgress(current);
        } else if (proposedStatus === 'Resolved') {
            verdict = validator.canTransitionToResolved(current);
        } else if (proposedStatus === 'Closed') {
            verdict = validator.canTransitionToClosed(current, gs.getUserID());
        } else {
            // 'Pending' carries no precondition per the transition matrix.
            verdict = { ok: true };
        }
        // VERDICT SHAPE IS VALIDATED, NOT ASSUMED. A missing verdict, a
        // non-object, a non-boolean `ok`, or a rejection with no message would
        // all read as "allowed" or as a blank blocking error, i.e. a silent
        // failure - which AAP Section 0.7.1 forbids.
        if (!verdict || typeof verdict !== 'object' || typeof verdict.ok !== 'boolean') {
            throw 'the validator returned a malformed verdict for ' + previousStatus + ' -> ' +
                  proposedStatus + ' (' + String(verdict) + ')';
        }
        if (verdict.ok === false && (typeof verdict.error !== 'string' || verdict.error === '')) {
            throw 'the validator rejected ' + previousStatus + ' -> ' + proposedStatus +
                  ' without supplying a message';
        }
    } catch (validatorError) {
        // Deny, explicitly. The diagnostic goes to the server log; the user
        // gets a generic message that leaks no internals.
        gs.error('x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions: the transition guard could not be evaluated for' +
                 ' case ' + caseSysId + ' (' + previousStatus + ' -> ' + proposedStatus + ') - ' +
                 validatorError + '. The save was aborted: an unevaluated transition is refused, never' +
                 ' allowed.');
        gs.addErrorMessage('This change could not be validated and has not been saved. Please try again, ' +
                           'and tell your administrator if it keeps happening.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }

    // Record any divergence so an operator can see when a combined
    // field-and-status save made the committed row stale.
    if (flowBlocked !== null && flowBlocked !== !verdict.ok) {
        gs.info('x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions: subflow x_casemgmt.' + subflowName +
                ' reported blocked=' + flowBlocked + ' while the in-flight evaluation reported blocked=' +
                (!verdict.ok) + ' for case ' + caseSysId + ' (' + previousStatus + ' -> ' + proposedStatus +
                '). The in-flight evaluation decides because it reflects the row as it will be saved.');
    }

    if (!verdict.ok) {
        // VERBATIM message from CaseTransitionValidator - do not paraphrase.
        gs.addErrorMessage(verdict.error);
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>cbea5a36ef6efe5a077e0548c45468ce</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_x_casemgmt_enforce_forward_transitions</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=cbea5a36ef6efe5a077e0548c45468ce"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_f6d63b3856121cac9b69215b2c46f64c
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_casemgmt_case</collection><condition/><description>Before-update on x_casemgmt_case: when previous.status == 'Resolved' AND current.status == 'Closed', sets current.closed_date = gs.nowDateTime() if not already populated. Replaces ArkCase ChangeCaseFileStateService.changeCaseState() retval.setClosed(now) (line 99 in acm-plugins/acm-default-plugins/acm-case-file-plugin/src/main/java/com/armedia/acm/plugins/casefile/service/ChangeCaseFileStateService.java). Per AAP Section 0.5.5 (Resolved->Closed auto-sets closed_date) and AAP Section 0.5.7 (closed_date DateTime, Auto-set on Close transition). Order=500 ensures this rule runs LAST among before-update rules so it only fires after all transition guards (block_terminal_closed, block_draft_backtransition, validate_assigned_agent_membership, clear_pending_reason_on_inprogress) have passed. Defensive .nil() guard preserves authoritative pre-set values from seed data and the validate_closed_transition Flow Designer subflow. Defense in depth with the subflow is intentional - this BR catches direct DB updates (Table API, scripted REST, GlideRecord scripts), the subflow catches interactive transitions through the form/UI. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>x_casemgmt_set_closed_date</name><order>500</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    // ServiceNow-native equivalent of ArkCase
    // ChangeCaseFileStateService.changeCaseState() line 99:
    //     if ("CLOSED".equals(newState)) { retval.setClosed(now); }
    // (acm-plugins/acm-default-plugins/acm-case-file-plugin/src/main/java/com/
    //  armedia/acm/plugins/casefile/service/ChangeCaseFileStateService.java)
    //
    // Per AAP Section 0.5.5: Resolved -> Closed transition auto-sets closed_date.
    // Per AAP Section 0.5.7: closed_date is "DateTime, Auto-set on Close transition".
    //
    // This BR runs alongside the Flow Designer subflow
    // ../flows/sub_flows/validate_closed_transition.xml; the redundancy is
    // intentional - this BR catches direct DB modifications (Table API,
    // scripted REST, GlideRecord scripts, bulk imports), the flow catches
    // interactive transitions through the form/UI.
    //
    // Order=500 makes this the LAST before-update rule on the table
    // (block_terminal_closed at order=100, block_draft_backtransition at
    // order=200, enforce_forward_transitions at order=250,
    // validate_assigned_agent_membership at order=300,
    // clear_pending_reason_on_inprogress at order=400 all run first).
    //
    // Running last is NOT the same as being skipped when an earlier rule
    // rejects the save. setAbortAction(true) cancels the WRITE; the platform
    // still runs this rule, and only current.isActionAborted() reveals the
    // pending abort. That is exactly how a denied Resolved -> Closed
    // previously produced a phantom Closed Date on the redisplayed form: the
    // order-250 rule had refused the transition, this rule ran anyway and
    // stamped the in-memory record, and the user saw a closed date on a case
    // the database still held as Resolved. The explicit guard below closes
    // that gap - closed_date is never stamped on a transition that is about
    // to be rejected.
    //
    // Defensive previous-null guard: the `previous` GlideRecord is null in
    // certain async/system contexts. If there is no previous state, no
    // transition can be detected, and the rule does nothing. The String()
    // cast normalizes the GlideElement to a primitive string for safe
    // === comparison; without the cast, GlideElement-vs-string equality
    // can behave inconsistently across releases.
    var prevStatus = previous ? String(previous.status) : '';
    var newStatus = String(current.status);

    // Verbatim Title Case status values per AAP Section 0.5.7 and the
    // sibling choice list ../choices/sys_choice_case_status.xml. The
    // labels ARE the stored values - ServiceNow Choice fields persist
    // the LABEL string by default, not an integer ID.
    if (prevStatus === 'Resolved' && newStatus === 'Closed') {
        // Do not stamp a rejected save. The order-250 rule refuses a close
        // attempted by a non-manager with "Only case managers can close
        // cases." and calls setAbortAction(true); the platform still runs
        // this rule, so without this check the redisplayed form would show a
        // Closed Date for a case that remains Resolved in the database.
        if (current.isActionAborted()) {
            return;
        }

        // Defensive .nil() guard: respect pre-set values from the
        // Flow Designer subflow (which fires in the same transaction
        // for interactive transitions and may have already stamped
        // the column) and from any future seed-data path that updates
        // an already-loaded case from Resolved to Closed. Without this
        // guard, a value already written by the subflow would be
        // overwritten by gs.nowDateTime() at this rule's execution
        // point - harmless in practice (both writers produce the same
        // millisecond-precision timestamp within a single transaction)
        // but unnecessary and slightly less clear in audit logs.
        if (current.closed_date.nil()) {
            current.closed_date = new GlideDateTime();
        }
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>f6d63b3856121cac9b69215b2c46f64c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_casemgmt_set_closed_date</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_x_casemgmt_set_closed_date</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=f6d63b3856121cac9b69215b2c46f64c"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
x_casemgmt_case_set_pendingtruetrueUI Action that transitions an In Progress case to Pending status. Visible to x_casemgmt_case_manager (always) and x_casemgmt_case_agent (only when assigned to the case via assigned_agent or member of assigned_group, per AAP Section 0.5.6 Assigned-only rule). Prompts the user for pending_reason (Awaiting Info / Awaiting Third Party / Other) on the client via a hybrid client+server pattern, then performs the transition on the server with defense-in-depth re-validation of role, status, assignment, and pending_reason. Per AAP Section 0.5.5 row 3 verbatim: "In Progress -> Pending: None; sets pending_reason (Awaiting Info / Awaiting Third Party / Other)". Companion to ../business_rules/x_casemgmt_clear_pending_reason_on_inprogress.xml which clears pending_reason on the reverse transition, and ../flows/sub_flows/validate_pending_transition.xml which handles the same transition at the Flow Designer workflow layer. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint, zero hardcoded sys_id literals, and zero PII.new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator().canShowAction(current, 'In Progress')truetruefalsefalsefalsefalsesecondaryfalsePause this case (provide a pending reason).truefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalseSet PendingonClickSetPending()300falsefalsefalsetruesys_ui_actionsystem2025-01-01 00:00:00global/af34b659d531b7a994da7d1f6a5e09f10x_casemgmt_case_set_pending82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5afsys_ui_action_x_casemgmt_case_set_pendingsystem2025-01-01 00:00:00x_casemgmt_case

inserted only after verifying that no row this test does not own holds the fixture slot or the pinned number</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>4f96a2dc8f3164886150163791d1c1b0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_4f96a2dc8f3164886150163791d1c1b0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date">6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=4f96a2dc8f3164886150163791d1c1b0"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>4f96a2dc8f3164886150163791d1c1b0</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>2084d525967fbf3fc8eef5e540151a93</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>4f96a2dc8f3164886150163791d1c1b0</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>24c1cec586f545a40f1e6f3298d87835</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "lookup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "07c9b35d04dc04336b72fa1a9c011e11",
            "prefix": "ATF-PORTAL-19",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-PORTAL-19 lookup fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "number": "CASE9000019",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    // A ROW IS DELETED ONLY WHEN IT IS PROVABLY THIS TEST'S OWN, AND A COLLISION IS
    // A FAILURE RATHER THAN SOMETHING TO CLEAR OUT OF THE WAY.
    //
    // Two independent things must hold before this step deletes anything: the row
    // must sit at the fixture's DETERMINISTIC sys_id - md5-derived, so a rebuild
    // converges on the same slot - AND it must carry this test's provenance marker,
    // a subject starting with the fixture's declared prefix, which is a string only
    // this test ever writes. A row occupying the slot without the marker is not
    // ours: it is named and left exactly as it was found.
    //
    // PINNED-NUMBER UNIQUENESS. This test pins number=CASE9000019 so the later
    // steps can drive the lookup with a known key. The endpoint resolves that key
    // with addQuery('number', trimmed).setLimit(1) and NO orderBy - see lookupCase()
    // in ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml - so if a SECOND row
    // ever carried the same number, which row the lookup returned would be
    // non-deterministic: this test could then assert against a foreign record, or
    // pass while the contract was genuinely broken.
    //
    // This step used to DELETE every other carrier of the pinned number, whatever
    // its sys_id - including, by its own admission, a hand-made or imported row. A
    // test must never destroy data it does not own: the loss lasted only as long as
    // the ATF rollback took to restore it, and a failed or nonstandard run made it
    // permanent. A collision now FAILS this step instead, naming every offending
    // row, and nothing is deleted, inserted or updated - the instance is left
    // exactly as it was found, for a human to adjudicate.
    //
    // The pinned number is deliberately out of sequence: the generator mints
    // CASE0000001 upward with 7-digit padding, so it would take nine million cases
    // to reach CASE9000019. A carrier this test did not create can therefore never
    // be something a run of it caused - it is foreign data, and stopping is the only
    // safe response. A unique per-run key would side-step the question entirely, but
    // step 3 feeds the number to a Send REST Request - Inbound step whose query
    // parameters are static configuration, so the key has to be known before the run
    // starts (see F11 in ../docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md).
    var PINNED_NUMBER = FIX[0].fields.number;
    var foreignSlots = [], strayCarriers = [];
    for (var s = 0; s < FIX.length; s++) {
        var slot = new GlideRecord(FIX[s].table);
        if (!slot.get(FIX[s].sys_id)) { continue; }
        var slotSubject = String(slot.getValue('subject') || '');
        if (FIX[s].prefix && slotSubject.indexOf(FIX[s].prefix) !== 0)
            foreignSlots.push(FIX[s].table + ':' + FIX[s].sys_id + ' [subject=' + slotSubject +
                ' created by ' + slot.getValue('sys_created_by') + ']');
    }
    var stray = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    stray.addQuery('number', PINNED_NUMBER);
    stray.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', FIX[0].sys_id);
    stray.query();
    while (stray.next())
        strayCarriers.push(stray.getUniqueValue() + ' [subject=' + stray.getValue('subject') +
            ' created by ' + stray.getValue('sys_created_by') + ']');
    chk('no foreign row occupies a fixture slot', '', foreignSlots.join(' | '));
    chk('no foreign row already carries the pinned lookup number ' + PINNED_NUMBER, '',
        strayCarriers.join(' | '));

    // Stop before touching anything: inserting the fixture on top of a second carrier
    // of the pinned number would deepen the ambiguity, and every later step would then
    // assert against a row nobody can identify.
    if (foreignSlots.length || strayCarriers.length) {
        stepResult.setOutputMessage([
            'REFUSING TO RUN - nothing was deleted, inserted or updated.',
            'fixture slots held by foreign data=' + foreignSlots.length +
                (foreignSlots.length ? ' :: ' + foreignSlots.join(' | ') : ''),
            'foreign rows carrying ' + PINNED_NUMBER + '=' + strayCarriers.length +
                (strayCarriers.length ? ' :: ' + strayCarriers.join(' | ') : ''),
            'This test owns exactly one row: sys_id ' + FIX[0].sys_id + ', carrying a subject' +
                ' that starts with ' + FIX[0].prefix + '. Adjudicate the rows above by hand.',
            'fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length + ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ')
        ].join('\n'));
        return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
    }

    var replaced = 0;
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) replaced++;
        }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }

    // The pinned number must have SURVIVED the insert. `number` is auto-numbered, so
    // an explicit value can only be trusted once it has been read back from the
    // stored row - a business rule or the number generator overwriting it would
    // otherwise silently redirect every later step to a different case.
    var stored = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture row is readable after insert', stored.get(FIX[0].sys_id));
    chk('the pinned lookup number was stored verbatim', PINNED_NUMBER, stored.getValue('number'));

    // Exactly ONE row may carry the pinned number, and it must be this fixture.
    // Counted by iteration rather than getRowCount() so the assertion names the
    // offending sys_id when it fails.
    var carriers = [];
    var carrier = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    carrier.addQuery('number', PINNED_NUMBER);
    carrier.query();
    while (carrier.next()) carriers.push(carrier.getUniqueValue());
    chk('exactly one case carries the pinned lookup number ' + PINNED_NUMBER, '1',
        String(carriers.length));
    chk('and the sole carrier of ' + PINNED_NUMBER + ' is this test\'s fixture',
        FIX[0].sys_id, carriers.join(','));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported line is
    // accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('foreign rows carrying ' + PINNED_NUMBER + ' found=' + strayCarriers.length +
        ' | fixture slots held by foreign data=' + foreignSlots.length +
        ' | own fixture rows replaced=' + replaced);
    notes.push('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('manager can read the fixture', gr.get('174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd'));
    chkTrue('manager may write assigned_group', gr.getElement('assigned_group').canWrite());
    chkTrue('manager may write assigned_agent', gr.getElement('assigned_agent').canWrite());
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('manager field-level write capability: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'manager field-level write capability', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>An In Progress case with exactly one Open child task</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>910063a00f869fa24ba2f17e2cfe9aee</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_910063a00f869fa24ba2f17e2cfe9aee</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 11 - Task-closure gate blocks In Progress to Resolved with the verbatim message">c225a1c9cc36ac254b284caeea84a9ae</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=910063a00f869fa24ba2f17e2cfe9aee"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>910063a00f869fa24ba2f17e2cfe9aee</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>327d4803b787214ab83d4df733d7f682</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "fe86c9e48b0f34254fd53ac38091d62b",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "case": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "nogroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "83f3e6d3ff140821649d17368601a963",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-08",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-08 draft without a group",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>10</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>ef081ae374bb6d510b263fcf5bd04858</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_ef081ae374bb6d510b263fcf5bd04858</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 09 - Transition Open to In Progress requires an assigned_agent in the assigned_group">02867a68434b5b09351e8a5d43b67223</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=ef081ae374bb6d510b263fcf5bd04858"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>ef081ae374bb6d510b263fcf5bd04858</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>4baeb8c581ca6e58b122d503890a7fae</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>ef081ae374bb6d510b263fcf5bd04858</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a707aec1eefb272324de7557185791c6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "d2b5064109ff252741f8c4c4d370b398",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-09",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-09 open without an agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>GET /api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=<valid> must answer HTTP 200 with exactly the three whitelisted keys. The whitelist is asserted negatively as well: the body must not contain assigned_group, assigned_agent, description, closed_date, requester_name, requester_email, sys_id. The call is made with no credentials at all. Each returned value is compared to the stored value exactly - status, subject AND opened_date - so a response carrying a different case's data, a placeholder or a reformatted date fails. Because lookupCase() resolves the number with setLimit(1) and no orderBy, step 1 also VERIFIES that exactly one row carries the pinned number CASE9000019 and that the row is its own fixture, so the lookup cannot resolve to a foreign record. Verification, never enforcement by deletion: a row this test does not own - one carrying that number, or occupying the fixture sys_id without this test subject marker - fails the test, is named in the failure message and is left exactly as it was found.</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error><name>ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><test_origin>manual</test_origin></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b"/></record_update>

Used by ../reports/x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_close.xml as the aggregation_source for the Manager View dashboard's "Average Time to Close" single-score widget (AAP Section 0.4.4 Widget 4). Resolves QA Checkpoint 4 Issue #1: implements Option A (function field) so the widget renders an actual Duration AVG instead of the "No data" placeholder. Not stored in a database column - the database evaluates the expression inside the query - but the dictionary row MUST carry virtual=false: `virtual` means the value comes from a virtual_type script provider, and setting it true with no provider makes the column return EMPTY for every row, which is exactly what happened before this was corrected. Not displayed on form/list (display=false); not auditable (audit=false). Read-only by definition for function fields.</comments><create_roles/><default_value/><defaultsort/><delete_roles/><dependent/><dependent_on_field/><display>false</display><dynamic_creation>false</dynamic_creation><dynamic_creation_script/><dynamic_default_value/><dynamic_ref_qual/><element>duration_to_close</element><element_reference>false</element_reference><foreign_database/><formula/><function_definition>glidefunction:datediff(closed_date,opened_date)</function_definition><function_field>true</function_field><internal_type display_value="">glide_duration</internal_type><mandatory>false</mandatory><max_length>40</max_length><name>x_casemgmt_case</name><next_element/><primary>false</primary><read_only>true</read_only><read_roles/><reference/><reference_cascade_rule/><reference_floats>false</reference_floats><reference_key/><reference_qual/><reference_qual_condition/><reference_type/><spell_check>false</spell_check><staged>false</staged><sys_class_name>sys_dictionary</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-02 19:14:11</sys_created_on><sys_id>deda209e938b435009aa70d19dba103b</sys_id><sys_name>Duration to Close</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_dictionary_x_casemgmt_case_duration_to_close</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-02 19:14:11</sys_updated_on><table_reference>false</table_reference><text_index>false</text_index><unique>false</unique><use_dependent_field>false</use_dependent_field><use_dynamic_default>false</use_dynamic_default><use_reference_qualifier>simple</use_reference_qualifier><virtual>false</virtual><virtual_type>script</virtual_type><widget/><write_roles/><xml_view>false</xml_view></sys_dictionary></record_update>

falseCOUNTfalsefalsefalsemediumfalsefalseManager View dashboard bar widget data source. Aggregates ALL records in x_casemgmt_case grouped by the priority Choice field with COUNT(*) per bucket. Four bars expected (Low, Medium, High, Critical) when seed data spans all priority tiers. UNFILTERED by design - shows the entire team backlog distribution across the urgency tiers including terminal-state cases, enabling managers to assess whether the team is over-indexed on Critical/High volume (signals operational stress) or whether Low/Medium cases dominate (signals normal intake mix). Replaces ArkCase's CaseFile.priority + Pentaho aggregation pipeline with a native GlideAggregate-backed sys_report. Different aggregation than x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_status (group by status) and x_casemgmt_all_cases_by_type (group by type); same Manager View dashboard audience per AAP Section 0.4.4. sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>GlideRecordSecure capability matrix for the viewer role</notes><order>7</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>1c4f58efc3119ad93e6ddafd8b1d6591</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_1c4f58efc3119ad93e6ddafd8b1d6591</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 04 - RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_viewer is read-only across all cases">be4d720d4d1f4225fb87e1ec63314d00</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=1c4f58efc3119ad93e6ddafd8b1d6591"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>1c4f58efc3119ad93e6ddafd8b1d6591</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>96b00e8aae0e715c6448438b1bb8fbf2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_viewer', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('viewer holds x_casemgmt_case_viewer', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_viewer'));
    var probe = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('viewer canRead any case', probe.get('cd17696587e11cb376a2964c217ff87f'));
    chk('viewer canCreate', 'false', String(probe.canCreate()));
    chk('viewer canWrite', 'false', String(probe.canWrite()));
    chk('viewer canDelete', 'false', String(probe.canDelete()));
    // GlideRecordSecure.getRowCount() is NOT ACL-filtered - it reports the raw
    // database count - so ANY threshold assertion on it can pass while the role
    // sees nothing at all. Measured on this instance with 11 cases: the demo agent
    // (assigned-only) reported getRowCount()=11 while iteration yielded 9. The
    // visible set is therefore built by ITERATION and compared id-for-id against an
    // authoritative set read through a plain GlideRecord, which bypasses ACLs by
    // design and is the only trustworthy statement of what rows exist.
    function idsOf(gr) {
        var o = [];
        while (gr.next()) { o.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); }
        o.sort();
        return o;
    }
    var authoritative = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    authoritative.query();
    var everyId = idsOf(authoritative);
    var secureAll = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secureAll.query();
    var visibleId = idsOf(secureAll);
    chk('viewer sees EVERY case (read all, exact set equality)',
        everyId.join(','), visibleId.join(','));
    chk('viewer visible-case count equals the stored row count',
        String(everyId.length), String(visibleId.length));
    chkTrue('the fixture the viewer has no relationship to is inside the visible set',
        visibleId.indexOf('cd17696587e11cb376a2964c217ff87f') > -1);
    chkTrue('the comparison is not being made over an almost-empty table (AAP 0.7.4 seeds 10+)',
        everyId.length >= 10);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('viewer capability matrix: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'viewer capability matrix', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>An Open case with a group but no agent</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>546705ea9f719bd7165713b09a67d47a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_546705ea9f719bd7165713b09a67d47a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 09 - Transition Open to In Progress requires an assigned_agent in the assigned_group">02867a68434b5b09351e8a5d43b67223</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=546705ea9f719bd7165713b09a67d47a"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>546705ea9f719bd7165713b09a67d47a</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a8f7c925723315b175365744def7bb61</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "d2b5064109ff252741f8c4c4d370b398",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-09",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-09 open without an agent",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
