RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_agent create, ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write, no delete">afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=6078b78dd8e107baf5d4d191a224ded1"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>6078b78dd8e107baf5d4d191a224ded1</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>06c404e0d2b5f84e44bd4947839fb7f6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>6078b78dd8e107baf5d4d191a224ded1</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>d1851c3ab3555a524cfb9e8597fc0b80</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('agent holds x_casemgmt_case_agent', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_agent'));
    chk('agent does NOT hold x_casemgmt_case_manager', 'false', String(gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager')));
    var mine = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('agent can read its assigned case', mine.get('42467a299b31d305bf03d85cf5882b9b'));
    chkTrue('agent canCreate', mine.canCreate());
    chkTrue('agent canWrite its assigned case', mine.canWrite());
    chk('agent canDelete', 'false', String(mine.canDelete()));
    var byGroup = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('agent can read the group-assigned case', byGroup.get('ad0ebc37a39bcca71d91cf84d09d6243'));
    chkTrue('agent canWrite the group-assigned case', byGroup.canWrite());
    var theirs = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chk('agent cannot read a case assigned to nobody', 'false', String(theirs.get('ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5')));

    // WRITE DENIAL ON AN UNASSIGNED ROW, asserted as a per-record decision and as a
    // stored value. Step 8 genuinely attempts the update through GlideRecordSecure - the
    // only scoped API that applies the write ACL - and asserts the row was not modified;
    // this block proves WHY it cannot happen and that nothing changed underneath.
    //
    // Two earlier shapes of step 8 are recorded so neither is reintroduced. It began as a
    // Record Query with assert type no_records_match_query, which passes whatever the write
    // authorization is because it never attempted a write. It was then a native Record
    // Update with assert type record_not_updated, which cannot work either: that step type
    // must LOCATE the row before it can attempt the write, and the assigned-only read ACL
    // has already hidden it, so the step aborts with "Unable to find record" instead of
    // observing a denial - measured as a real suite failure before it was rebuilt.
    //
    // A plain GlideRecord is used deliberately: it loads the row WITHOUT applying the
    // read ACL (measured on this release), which is the only way to interrogate a row
    // the agent may not see. canRead/canWrite/canDelete on that loaded row are then the
    // platform's own per-record ACL decisions for the impersonated identity, not a
    // table-level guess. GlideRecordSecure cannot serve here because it refuses to load
    // the row at all, which would leave write authorization untested.
    var unassignedProbe = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the unassigned fixture still exists, so the denials below are about ACLs and not absence',
        unassignedProbe.get('ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5'));
    chk('agent canRead is FALSE for the unassigned case', 'false', String(unassignedProbe.canRead()));
    chk('agent canWrite is FALSE for the unassigned case', 'false', String(unassignedProbe.canWrite()));
    chk('agent canDelete is FALSE for the unassigned case', 'false', String(unassignedProbe.canDelete()));
    chk('the unassigned case still holds its original priority - step 8 changed nothing',
        'Medium', unassignedProbe.getValue('priority'));
    // And the secured path cannot even reach the row to attempt a write.
    var secureWrite = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secureWrite.addQuery('sys_id', 'ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5');
    secureWrite.query();
    chk('a secured query cannot iterate to the unassigned row', 'false', String(secureWrite.next()));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('agent capability matrix and assigned-only narrowing: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'agent capability matrix and assigned-only narrowing', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

})(current);]]></calculation><choice/><choice_field/><choice_table/><column_label>Case</column_label><comments>Mandatory reference to the parent case (x_casemgmt_case). The single most important field on the x_casemgmt_case_party table - it ties every party row (Person or Organization) back to its parent case. Replaces ArkCase PersonAssociation.parentId/parentType/parentTitle polymorphic parent linkage (and the equivalent on PersonOrganizationAssociation); in this POC the parent is always a x_casemgmt_case row, so the polymorphism is collapsed into a single fixed-target reference. Makes a case-form Related List of parties POSSIBLE (AAP Section 0.4.4) but does not create one: no sys_ui_related_list configuration was authored for x_casemgmt_case, so no parties related list renders on the case form today. Used by case_agent "Assigned only" ACL conditions on x_casemgmt_case_party via the accessor current.getElement('case') to reach the parent case's assigned_agent / assigned_group (a literal current.case dot-walk cannot compile - 'case' is a JavaScript reserved word) (AAP Section 0.5.6). Cascade rule is "none" - deleting a parent case does NOT auto-cascade-delete its child parties (POC-safe default; manual cleanup required). Seed data resolves the parent-case sys_id by lookup of x_casemgmt_case.number via ../scripts/seed_demo_data.js (no hardcoded sys_ids, per AAP Section 0.7.2).</comments><create_roles/><default_value/><defaultsort/><delete_roles/><dependent/><dependent_on_field/><display>false</display><dynamic_creation>false</dynamic_creation><dynamic_creation_script/><dynamic_default_value/><dynamic_ref_qual/><element>case</element><element_reference>false</element_reference><foreign_database/><formula/><function_definition/><function_field>false</function_field><internal_type <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures - only rows carrying this test's own marker are ever deleted</notes><order>10</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>0b77e1582f682491200db29943f5565f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_0b77e1582f682491200db29943f5565f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 19 - Portal contract: lookup of a valid number returns only status, subject, opened_date">6e0aaff769e10fa94776c9722f94aa7b</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=0b77e1582f682491200db29943f5565f"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>0b77e1582f682491200db29943f5565f</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>31d132aeeb8240bbe9c895ac3accde26</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>0b77e1582f682491200db29943f5565f</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>c1456ad8a2473365c2a2754780dce86f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "lookup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "07c9b35d04dc04336b72fa1a9c011e11",
            "prefix": "ATF-PORTAL-19",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-PORTAL-19 lookup fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "number": "CASE9000019",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    //
    // OWNERSHIP, NOT JUST THE SLOT. The pinned sys_id on its own is not proof of
    // ownership: a row occupying that slot must ALSO carry this test's provenance
    // marker - a subject starting with the fixture's declared prefix - before it is
    // deleted. One that does not is named and left exactly as it was found, and this
    // step fails: cleanup never destroys data this test did not create.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [], foreignSlots = {}, foreignReport = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (!old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { continue; }
        var slotSubject = String(old.getValue('subject') || '');
        if (FIX[d].prefix && slotSubject.indexOf(FIX[d].prefix) !== 0) {
            foreignSlots[FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id] = true;
            foreignReport.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id + ' [subject=' + slotSubject +
                ' created by ' + old.getValue('sys_created_by') + ']');
            continue;
        }
        old.setWorkflow(false);
        if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
        else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));
    chk('no foreign row occupied a fixture slot', '', foreignReport.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id) && !foreignSlots[FIX[q].table + ':' + FIX[q].sys_id])
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | fixture slots held by foreign data=' + foreignReport.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_agent create, ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write, no delete">afd33eebe6f49b746316b620f3886027</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=3c3ef25ced2dc93cd7ae4b0617e9f2ad"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>3c3ef25ced2dc93cd7ae4b0617e9f2ad</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>2a85b7c9b585e74f8382a88de92cea55</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>3c3ef25ced2dc93cd7ae4b0617e9f2ad</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>dfa640dc52da1a0c086076650c82d9c2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }

    // WHY THIS STEP IS A SCRIPT AND NOT A NATIVE "Record Update" STEP.
    //
    // The obvious way to prove "the agent may not write an unassigned case" is a
    // native Record Update step with Enforce security = 1 and assert type
    // record_not_updated. That was tried and it CANNOT work here. Measured in the real
    // ATF client test runner, that step failed with:
    //
    //   FAILURE: Unable to find record 'ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5' in table
    //   'x_casemgmt_case'
    //
    // ATF's Record Update step must LOCATE the row before it can attempt a write and
    // observe a denial, and the assigned-only READ ACL has already made that row
    // invisible to the impersonated agent - which step 6 proves independently. Read
    // denial therefore precedes write denial: the platform never reaches an
    // "update refused" outcome for the step to assert on, and the step aborts instead.
    // The protection is STRONGER than the native step can express, not weaker.
    //
    // A TRAP THIS STEP DELIBERATELY AVOIDS. A plain GlideRecord does NOT enforce ACLs.
    // Measured on this instance while impersonating x_casemgmt_demo_agent: plain
    // GlideRecord.get() on the unassigned row returns true and canWrite() returns
    // false, yet update() still SUCCEEDS and leaves priority=High. A negative-write
    // proof must therefore never be built on plain GlideRecord.update() - it would
    // report a write the ACL layer was never asked about, and pass while the
    // protection was broken. Plain GlideRecord is used below only to READ the stored
    // value and to interrogate the platform's own per-record decisions.
    //
    // SCOPE NOTE (AAP Section 0.5.6). For x_casemgmt_case_agent the read scope and the
    // write scope are the same set - "Assigned only" - so a case row that the agent can
    // READ but must not WRITE does not exist by design. The record-level write refusal
    // is consequently enforced at the read gate, which is what this step asserts. The
    // separate case of a readable row with a forbidden FIELD (assigned_group,
    // assigned_agent) is covered by ATF 05.
    var UNASSIGNED = 'ad246e3efcb417cf87cc4d8eb2bc6df5';

    // The identity is asserted FIRST. Every denial below is only meaningful as the agent:
    // run as admin the same code would report canWrite=true and the secured write would
    // succeed, so without this the step could pass an unimpersonated run while proving
    // nothing. Measured: with step 2's Impersonate skipped, this assertion is what fails.
    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_agent', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('the caller holds x_casemgmt_case_agent', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_agent'));
    chk('the caller does NOT hold x_casemgmt_case_manager', 'false',
        String(gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager')));

    // Baseline, read with a plain GlideRecord because the secured API cannot see it.
    var before = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the unassigned fixture exists to be attacked', before.get(UNASSIGNED));
    var priorityBefore = before.getValue('priority');
    chkTrue('the baseline priority was captured', String(priorityBefore || '').length > 0);
    chk('the fixture is genuinely unassigned to this agent - no assigned_agent',
        '', String(before.getValue('assigned_agent') || ''));
    chk('the fixture is genuinely unassigned to this agent - no assigned_group',
        '', String(before.getValue('assigned_group') || ''));

    // 1. The security-enforced API cannot even load the row.
    var sec = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chk('GlideRecordSecure.get cannot load the unassigned row', 'false',
        String(sec.get(UNASSIGNED)));

    // 2. Nor can a secured query iterate to it.
    var reachable = 0;
    var secQ = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secQ.addQuery('sys_id', UNASSIGNED);
    secQ.query();
    while (secQ.next()) reachable++;
    chk('a secured query reaches zero rows for the unassigned sys_id', '0', String(reachable));

    // 3. The platform's own per-record decisions are all DENY.
    var probe = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('a plain GlideRecord can load the row, so the decisions below are real',
        probe.get(UNASSIGNED));
    chk('canRead is denied', 'false', String(probe.canRead()));
    chk('canWrite is denied', 'false', String(probe.canWrite()));
    chk('canDelete is denied', 'false', String(probe.canDelete()));

    // 4. A GENUINE security-enforced write ATTEMPT. GlideRecordSecure is the only
    //    scoped API that applies the write ACL, so the attempt is made through it and
    //    its outcome asserted - rather than querying and inferring a refusal.
    var attempted = 'no row reachable through the secured API';
    var secW = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secW.addQuery('sys_id', UNASSIGNED);
    secW.query();
    if (secW.next()) {
        secW.setValue('priority', 'High');
        attempted = 'update() returned [' + secW.update() + ']';
    }
    chk('the secured write attempt could not modify the unassigned row',
        'no row reachable through the secured API', attempted);

    // 5. And the stored row is byte-for-byte unchanged afterwards.
    var after = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the row still exists after the refused write', after.get(UNASSIGNED));
    chk('priority is unchanged after the refused write', priorityBefore,
        after.getValue('priority'));

    stepResult.setOutputMessage('agent write on an unassigned case refused: secured get=false, ' +
        'secured query rows=' + reachable + ', canWrite=false, priority still [' +
        after.getValue('priority') + '] :: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'agent write on an unassigned case is refused', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>A Resolved case assigned to the demo agent</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a91f91029e7788fae47f6d660a2de2a6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_a91f91029e7788fae47f6d660a2de2a6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 12 - Resolved to Closed requires the manager role and auto-sets closed_date">60af3ed556ef6085dd5cb0b343ec1888</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=a91f91029e7788fae47f6d660a2de2a6"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>a91f91029e7788fae47f6d660a2de2a6</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>908917361734013bf954081446dd9948</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>a91f91029e7788fae47f6d660a2de2a6</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>ab290f46e4ac6582cd85deafb3431c58</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "resolved",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-12",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-12 resolved case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Resolved",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_atf_test_b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>Form-level companion to ATF 11 for the verbatim message "All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.". Runs in the ATF client test runner: the case form is opened, the status field is set and the form is submitted, so the block is exercised through the same UI path a user takes. AUTOMATED COVERAGE: the submit reaches the server, the stored row is proven unchanged, and step 7 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. ATF has no step type that can read the classic form error banner - its only text-on-page assertion is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM rather than the platform form this test drives, and "Submit a Form" exposes only form_ui and assert_type inputs. The rendered wording is therefore a MANUAL observation: read it from the runner step-5 screenshot, per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md. It is not counted as automated coverage anywhere.</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error><name>ATF 15 - Form: resolving a case with an open task is blocked on the form</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ATF 15 - Form: resolving a case with an open task is blocked on the form</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><test_origin>manual</test_origin></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c"/></record_update>

Data model: case, task and party schema per AAP 0.5.7">4779cf2ff32768ffd2afaee103133709</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=11783fb443472625566085bb0d4278b0"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>11783fb443472625566085bb0d4278b0</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>bd35aebc7ba4846525fca0697b5339a5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    // Every application-defined column on a table, sorted. The collection row
    // (element empty) and the platform's own inherited sys_* columns are excluded,
    // so what is left is exactly what this deliverable declares. Used for SET
    // EQUALITY, which is what makes an UNDECLARED extra field fail the test - a
    // per-field existence loop alone can never notice one.
    function appElements(table) {
        var out = [], d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table);
        d.addNotNullQuery('element');
        d.query();
        while (d.next()) {
            var e = d.getValue('element');
            if (e && e.indexOf('sys_') !== 0) { out.push(e); }
        }
        out.sort();
        return out;
    }

    var TASK_SPEC = [
        ['case','reference',32,true,'x_casemgmt_case'], ['subject','string',255,true,''],
        ['type','string',40,false,''], ['status','string',40,false,''],
        ['assigned_to','reference',32,true,'sys_user'], ['due_date','glide_date',40,true,'']
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < TASK_SPEC.length; i++) {
        var sp = TASK_SPEC[i], d = dict('x_casemgmt_case_task', sp[0]);
        chkTrue('x_casemgmt_case_task.' + sp[0] + ' exists', !!d);
        if (!d) continue;
        chk('x_casemgmt_case_task.' + sp[0] + ' type', sp[1], d.getValue('internal_type'));
        chk('x_casemgmt_case_task.' + sp[0] + ' max_length', sp[2], d.getValue('max_length'));
        chk('x_casemgmt_case_task.' + sp[0] + ' mandatory', sp[3], d.getValue('mandatory') == '1');
        if (sp[4]) chk('x_casemgmt_case_task.' + sp[0] + ' reference', sp[4], d.getValue('reference'));
    }
    var PARTY_SPEC = [
        ['case','reference',32,true,'x_casemgmt_case'], ['party_type','string',40,true,''],
        ['person','reference',32,false,'sys_user'], ['organization','reference',32,false,'core_company'],
        ['role_label','string',100,true,'']
    ];
    for (var j = 0; j < PARTY_SPEC.length; j++) {
        var ps = PARTY_SPEC[j], pd = dict('x_casemgmt_case_party', ps[0]);
        chkTrue('x_casemgmt_case_party.' + ps[0] + ' exists', !!pd);
        if (!pd) continue;
        chk('x_casemgmt_case_party.' + ps[0] + ' type', ps[1], pd.getValue('internal_type'));
        chk('x_casemgmt_case_party.' + ps[0] + ' max_length', ps[2], pd.getValue('max_length'));
        chk('x_casemgmt_case_party.' + ps[0] + ' mandatory', ps[3], pd.getValue('mandatory') == '1');
        if (ps[4]) chk('x_casemgmt_case_party.' + ps[0] + ' reference', ps[4], pd.getValue('reference'));
    }
    chk('task.type choices', 'Investigation,Review,Follow-up,Other', choices('x_casemgmt_case_task','type').join(','));
    chk('task.status choices', 'Open,In Progress,Closed', choices('x_casemgmt_case_task','status').join(','));
    chk('party.party_type choices', 'Person,Organization', choices('x_casemgmt_case_party','party_type').join(','));
    // EXACT FIELD SETS on both child tables. `number` is on each list because AAP
    // 0.4.1 mandates a sys_number counter for case_task (TASK) and case_party
    // (PARTY) alongside the 0.5.7 field lists; nothing else is permitted.
    var TASK_FIELDS = ['assigned_to', 'case', 'due_date', 'number', 'status', 'subject', 'type'];
    chk('x_casemgmt_case_task carries EXACTLY the declared field set',
        TASK_FIELDS.join(','), appElements('x_casemgmt_case_task').join(','));
    chk('x_casemgmt_case_task field count', String(TASK_FIELDS.length),
        String(appElements('x_casemgmt_case_task').length));
    var PARTY_FIELDS = ['case', 'number', 'organization', 'party_type', 'person', 'role_label'];
    chk('x_casemgmt_case_party carries EXACTLY the declared field set',
        PARTY_FIELDS.join(','), appElements('x_casemgmt_case_party').join(','));
    chk('x_casemgmt_case_party field count', String(PARTY_FIELDS.length),
        String(appElements('x_casemgmt_case_party').length));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('task and party schema (AAP 0.5.7): checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'task and party schema (AAP 0.5.7)', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>11783fb443472625566085bb0d4278b0</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>c2036548579794244529f1595c952725</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('pending_reason choices', 'Awaiting Info,Awaiting Third Party,Other',
        choices('x_casemgmt_case','pending_reason').join(','));
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('0e87e901adab05218fcbf7d5a84bc2c2');
    chk('pending_reason is empty after returning to In Progress', '', gr.getValue('pending_reason') || '');
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('pending_reason choice set: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'pending_reason choice set', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

Portal contract: lookup of an unknown number returns 404 with the verbatim message">7ab5876adb5664a2e51acd22c663ab76</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=6f848d4da76256133f870cf81dcfdefa"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>6f848d4da76256133f870cf81dcfdefa</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>bd3549fb11b169edc4a5d313bbc6337b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>6f848d4da76256133f870cf81dcfdefa</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>e67079ed8150b96a3783cd33b90e87e5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.addQuery('number', 'CASE9999999');
    gr.query();
    chk('CASE9999999 does not exist', '0', String(gr.getRowCount()));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('no case may carry the probe number: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'no case may carry the probe number', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

Form: resolving a case with an open task is blocked on the form">b90847a8102f3e04bef26db08270b42c</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=84a4ea6bb7ae771361df6a3548cec456"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>84a4ea6bb7ae771361df6a3548cec456</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>0415b520afca0f75dbe7c0f689e3727c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>84a4ea6bb7ae771361df6a3548cec456</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>4effecf4787f0878036683337e8c6a94</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "920320ac7154793fc020936272624c5b",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "case": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    // GUARD FOR THE CLIENT HANDOFF (step 3, "Open an Existing Record").
    // That step does not read the row itself: the browser calls the platform's own
    // GLOBAL-scope Script Include TestExecutorAjax.validateFormParameters, which
    // resolves it with a plain GlideRecord. If this application's tables refuse
    // cross-scope reads, that lookup returns nothing and the step fails with
    // "Table 'x_casemgmt_case' does not have a record with id '...'" - which reads
    // like a missing fixture but is really a table access-policy problem. The five
    // boolean cross-scope columns on sys_db_object (ws_access, read_access,
    // create_access, update_access, delete_access) must be TRUE; see
    // ../tables/x_casemgmt_case.xml. Asserting the fixture is resolvable HERE turns
    // that misleading downstream failure into a precise one, and it also removes any
    // dependence on a row left behind by an earlier run.
    for (var g = 0; g < FIX.length; g++) {
        var reread = new GlideRecord(FIX[g].table);
        chkTrue('fixture ' + FIX[g].label + ' is resolvable by sys_id after insert (the client form step resolves it the same way)',
            reread.get(FIX[g].sys_id));
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>8</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9c3c58ec9e0c2bb0065dd823a4a02e09</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_9c3c58ec9e0c2bb0065dd823a4a02e09</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 10 - In Progress to Pending sets pending_reason, Pending to In Progress clears it">b6cc513ef49eb5be8f42f752cfaf960b</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=9c3c58ec9e0c2bb0065dd823a4a02e09"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9c3c58ec9e0c2bb0065dd823a4a02e09</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>2e73844eafc1ca711f7ceb3e7b0291cb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "0e87e901adab05218fcbf7d5a84bc2c2",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-10",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-10 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9c3c58ec9e0c2bb0065dd823a4a02e09</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>48554aa8d8c2514a2486d33761b3d463</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "probe",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "cfdc67741a52236340f593d0229635a8",
            "prefix": "ATF-DM-01",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-DM-01 data model probe",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];
    // `status` is deliberately ABSENT from the fixture above. This test asserts
    // that a NEW case defaults to Draft (AAP 0.5.7). Supplying the value here made
    // step 2's Record Validation and the default check in step 3 tautological: they
    // only proved the insert wrote back what the test itself had set. With the key
    // omitted, the only thing that can populate the column is the platform's own
    // configuration of it - the dictionary default plus the choice list - so both
    // checks now observe the platform's default rather than the test's own input.

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

Form: a Closed case cannot be moved out of the terminal state on the form">07f1427f80169c8644b47ead9d5c1b78</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=d44ab6bfcb45f0426e1af9aec862f745"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>d44ab6bfcb45f0426e1af9aec862f745</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>009919dd8b9185573ae84a5ee4c3098f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>d44ab6bfcb45f0426e1af9aec862f745</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9d6e324ec40bdd9f4c0d3f17eb2a4938</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 08:28:28</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "518799bb2fe107d3647146a08b3af61d",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-17",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-17 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // VERBATIM MESSAGE, asserted before the fixtures are removed.
    //
    // WHAT ATF CAN AND CANNOT SEE HERE. Step 4 proves the form offers no way out of
    // the terminal state - the application freezes a Closed case, so Status is
    // read-only and cannot be set at all - and step 5 proves the stored row is still
    // Closed. ATF ships no step type that can read the classic form's error banner:
    // the only text-on-page assertion in the framework is "Assert Text on Page
    // (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM and not the platform form these
    // tests drive. Here the form never reaches a submit, so this test raises no
    // banner of its own to read. That the message is RENDERED is therefore a MANUAL
    // observation - see docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md - and is not claimed as
    // automated coverage anywhere; what the runner's step-4 screenshot does show is
    // the Status control disabled and labelled read-only.
    //
    // What IS automated is the string itself. Without the block below this test could
    // pass while the message was missing or reworded, because nothing it asserted
    // depended on the wording. Asserting the exact string here, in the same
    // transaction and against the same fixture the form just proved frozen, means a
    // missing or altered message turns this test RED.
    var gate = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture case is still present for the message assertion',
        gate.get('518799bb2fe107d3647146a08b3af61d'));
    chk('the case is still Closed, and the frozen form offered no way to change it',
        'Closed', gate.getValue('status'));
    var validator = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var verdict = validator.validateNoBacktransition(gate.getValue('status'), 'In Progress');
    chk('the transition out of Closed is refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
    chk('the blocking message is verbatim (AAP 0.7.4)',
        'Closed cases are terminal and cannot be modified.', String(verdict.error));
    // stepResult.setOutputMessage OVERWRITES the step's output on every call - it does
    // NOT append. Measured in the client runner: this step called it three times and
    // only the last line survived, so the message-assertion evidence below was written
    // and then silently discarded. Every line is therefore accumulated here and emitted
    // exactly once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = ['message asserted server-side: [' + verdict.error + ']'];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "closed",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "518799bb2fe107d3647146a08b3af61d",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-17",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-17 closed case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Closed",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
