sys_update_xml.name: sys_atf_step_5d9824ef9e3c76d195044f5f13c187ed
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>21</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>5d9824ef9e3c76d195044f5f13c187ed</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_5d9824ef9e3c76d195044f5f13c187ed</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 06 - RBAC mirror on x_casemgmt_case_task and x_casemgmt_case_party (manager, viewer)">f6256084e214d739604fe63b4bcba018</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=5d9824ef9e3c76d195044f5f13c187ed"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>5d9824ef9e3c76d195044f5f13c187ed</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>150251ea0fc6a9908ba35c969291cbe8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "parent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 parent case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "94a0371e5a4444df0b4fecab96375fde",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "165fe5387948213f9b16f8ade71c0749",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>5d9824ef9e3c76d195044f5f13c187ed</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>bccc509584b5dd17ceddbb6504378db8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_manager has full CRUD (AAP 0.5.6)">64dd92fb6ce07b6b62d2978edd0231f2</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=a1c14fa283b0aefe08da98ae10ac316f"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>a1c14fa283b0aefe08da98ae10ac316f</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>330989d33b8c9d8c3afc6920fde153f1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>a1c14fa283b0aefe08da98ae10ac316f</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a22ac5cff305f48751653920eeffff5c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    chk('impersonated user', 'x_casemgmt_demo_manager', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('manager holds x_casemgmt_case_manager', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager'));
    var probe = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('manager can read the unassigned case', probe.get('93eeda729062207211ec3270cbf1545e'));
    chkTrue('manager canCreate', probe.canCreate());
    chkTrue('manager canRead', probe.canRead());
    chkTrue('manager canWrite', probe.canWrite());
    chkTrue('manager canDelete', probe.canDelete());
    // GlideRecordSecure.getRowCount() is NOT ACL-filtered - it reports the raw
    // database count - so ANY threshold assertion on it can pass while the role
    // sees nothing at all. Measured on this instance with 11 cases: the demo agent
    // (assigned-only) reported getRowCount()=11 while iteration yielded 9. The
    // visible set is therefore built by ITERATION and compared id-for-id against an
    // authoritative set read through a plain GlideRecord, which bypasses ACLs by
    // design and is the only trustworthy statement of what rows exist.
    function idsOf(gr) {
        var o = [];
        while (gr.next()) { o.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); }
        o.sort();
        return o;
    }
    var authoritative = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    authoritative.query();
    var everyId = idsOf(authoritative);
    var secureAll = new GlideRecordSecure('x_casemgmt_case');
    secureAll.query();
    var visibleId = idsOf(secureAll);
    chk('manager sees EVERY case (read all, exact set equality)',
        everyId.join(','), visibleId.join(','));
    chk('manager visible-case count equals the stored row count',
        String(everyId.length), String(visibleId.length));
    chkTrue('the ASSIGNED fixture is inside the manager visible set',
        visibleId.indexOf('6fab7dd278e415c8e5bdea665c89d8a5') > -1);
    chkTrue('the UNASSIGNED fixture is inside the manager visible set',
        visibleId.indexOf('93eeda729062207211ec3270cbf1545e') > -1);
    chkTrue('the comparison is not being made over an almost-empty table (AAP 0.7.4 seeds 10+)',
        everyId.length >= 10);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('manager capability matrix: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'manager capability matrix', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>8</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>efd206e53b09e2bacd2b72b9afcd3c49</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_efd206e53b09e2bacd2b72b9afcd3c49</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 13 - Prohibited transition: any status back to Draft">8f85ec769b09e59e6d761aa58891de74</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=efd206e53b09e2bacd2b72b9afcd3c49"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>efd206e53b09e2bacd2b72b9afcd3c49</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>8ab9d7c6f8747a6f036309e3da7f2a36</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "2c5e1c1b024c34d83ce0524539985203",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 open case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "134fa9e9d8acc56cc113172b2535927f",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

Transition Draft to Open requires assigned_group">9eca1a92704f7acf745e7560fa46728a</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=a602c391d9fdaed627e063a6dd8e2f00"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>a602c391d9fdaed627e063a6dd8e2f00</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>030572d4ac661bbd077f7de3a09d3d5c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>a602c391d9fdaed627e063a6dd8e2f00</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b8f0ad191db84a582574be6172e2e974</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('83f3e6d3ff140821649d17368601a963');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    var withGroup = v.canTransitionToOpen(gr);
    chkTrue('canTransitionToOpen is true once assigned_group is set', withGroup.ok);
    gr.setValue('assigned_group', '');
    var without = v.canTransitionToOpen(gr);
    chk('canTransitionToOpen is false with no assigned_group', 'false', String(without.ok));
    chkTrue('a blocking message is supplied', String(without.error || '').length > 0);
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('validator message: [' + without.error + ']');
    notes.push('validator verdict for Draft to Open: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'validator verdict for Draft to Open', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

Resolved to Closed requires the manager role and auto-sets closed_date">60af3ed556ef6085dd5cb0b343ec1888</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=fa85e7115d8e7c0b98feb36a8ddeaadf"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>fa85e7115d8e7c0b98feb36a8ddeaadf</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>784134efd18336ead9d0d17a8077664c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>fa85e7115d8e7c0b98feb36a8ddeaadf</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>f7e08a98a6176eba5647bbd12823c94a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "resolved",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-12",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-12 resolved case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Resolved",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>POST /api/x_casemgmt/case_submit with Content-Type application/json must answer HTTP 201 carrying the generated case number and the verbatim message "Your case has been submitted", and the created case must land with status Draft and a CASE0000001-format number. Steps 2-8 assert that contract through the ATF-instrumented Send REST Request - Inbound step, which carries no credentials: the platform serves it as guest, its response carries X-Is-Logged-In false and the row it creates is guest-owned, so the 201 contract is asserted on behalf of a genuinely unauthenticated caller - and because ATF instruments that step type the insert sits inside the rollback context, measured on 2026-08-08 when a run whose step 10 had been skipped still came back clean. That step type cannot vary its request, so step 9 covers the rest of the anonymous surface from a server-side script with no credentials, WITHOUT persisting anything: an unauthenticated POST whose payload the handler must reject comes back carrying the handler own verbatim validation message, which a 401 or 403 from the authenticator could never do; the case step 2 submitted is read back through the anonymous lookup endpoint and exposes only status, subject and opened_date; and a census proves neither of those calls persisted a case. An earlier design submitted a valid case from that script - an outbound call from a script is NOT ATF-instrumented, so the rollback reversed this test own cleanup delete and every run left one synthetic case behind. It no longer does: this test asserts its own cleanliness.</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error><name>ATF 18 - Portal contract: anonymous submit returns 201 with the new case number</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a4fab153ebcda77e4c2d7b8905f7d19e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ATF 18 - Portal contract: anonymous submit returns 201 with the new case number</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_a4fab153ebcda77e4c2d7b8905f7d19e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><test_origin>manual</test_origin></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=a4fab153ebcda77e4c2d7b8905f7d19e"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>5</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>3c7766de1af36e9562517f2a8dd622a7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_3c7766de1af36e9562517f2a8dd622a7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 01 - Data model: case, task and party schema per AAP 0.5.7">4779cf2ff32768ffd2afaee103133709</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=3c7766de1af36e9562517f2a8dd622a7"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>3c7766de1af36e9562517f2a8dd622a7</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>2ec39e9bda5977ed74b1bcc616d46389</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "probe",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "cfdc67741a52236340f593d0229635a8",
            "prefix": "ATF-DM-01",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-DM-01 data model probe",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "920320ac7154793fc020936272624c5b",
            "prefix": "ATF-UI-15",
            "fields": {
                "case": "79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782",
                "subject": "ATF-UI-15 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // VERBATIM MESSAGE, asserted before the fixtures are removed.
    //
    // WHAT ATF CAN AND CANNOT SEE HERE. The submit in step 5 is refused by the
    // server and step 6 proves the stored row did not change, but ATF ships no step
    // type that can read the classic form's error banner: the only text-on-page
    // assertion in the framework is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets
    // the Custom UI DOM and not the platform form these tests drive, and the
    // "Submit a Form" step exposes only `form_ui` and `assert_type` inputs. So the
    // fact that the message is RENDERED is a MANUAL observation - see the runner's
    // step-5 screenshot and docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md - and is not claimed as
    // automated coverage anywhere.
    //
    // What IS automated is the string itself. Without the block below this test could
    // pass while the message was missing or reworded, because nothing it asserted
    // depended on the wording. Asserting the exact string here, in the same
    // transaction and against the same fixture the form just submitted, means a
    // missing or altered message turns this test RED.
    var gate = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    chkTrue('the fixture case is still present for the message assertion',
        gate.get('79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782'));
    chk('the case is still In Progress, so the refused submit changed nothing',
        'In Progress', gate.getValue('status'));
    var validator = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('the open child task is still open, so the gate is genuinely closed',
        '1', String(validator.getOpenTaskCountForCase('79e32263ed39688411cc07c065545782')));
    var verdict = validator.canTransitionToResolved(gate);
    chk('the Resolved transition is refused', 'false', String(verdict.ok));
    chk('the blocking message is verbatim (AAP 0.7.4)',
        'All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.', String(verdict.error));
    // stepResult.setOutputMessage OVERWRITES the step's output on every call - it does
    // NOT append. Measured in the client runner: this step called it three times and
    // only the last line survived, so the message-assertion evidence below was written
    // and then silently discarded. Every line is therefore accumulated here and emitted
    // exactly once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = ['message asserted server-side: [' + verdict.error + ']'];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

no credentials on the request - is served, enforces its own validation perimeter and persists nothing</notes><order>9</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9aaec527e3a8443eab53e28c8dc614f9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_9aaec527e3a8443eab53e28c8dc614f9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 18 - Portal contract: anonymous submit returns 201 with the new case number">a4fab153ebcda77e4c2d7b8905f7d19e</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=9aaec527e3a8443eab53e28c8dc614f9"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9aaec527e3a8443eab53e28c8dc614f9</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>1d8596fef91da48b70cd6125662067d0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9aaec527e3a8443eab53e28c8dc614f9</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>7b1f7b99514155cc7d085e3926b42cbe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 07:08:21</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    function anonCall(method, path, body) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setHttpMethod(method);
        r.setEndpoint(String(gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri')).replace(/\/$/, '') + path);
        r.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        if (body) {
            r.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
            r.setRequestBody(body);
        }
        var resp = r.execute();
        return { status: String(resp.getStatusCode()), body: String(resp.getBody() || '') };
    }
    function envelope(raw) {
        try { return JSON.parse(raw).result || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
    }

    // THE ANONYMOUS DIMENSION, ASSERTED WITHOUT LEAVING ANYTHING BEHIND.
    //
    // Measured, not assumed: the Send REST Request - Inbound step in step 2 sends no
    // credentials unless a basic or mutual auth profile is configured on it, and none
    // is - so the platform serves that call as `guest`. Its response carries
    // X-Is-Logged-In: false and the row it creates is owned by guest. ATF instruments
    // that step type, so the row IS inside the rollback context: in the run captured
    // on 2026-08-08 the Rollback batch removed the submitted case even though step 10
    // had been skipped by an earlier failure. Steps 2-8 therefore already assert the
    // 201-with-a-number contract on behalf of an UNAUTHENTICATED caller, and the row
    // is cleaned up whether or not step 10 gets to run.
    //
    // What that step type cannot do is vary its request: its inputs are static
    // configuration, it cannot read a value produced earlier in the same run, and it
    // cannot be pointed at a second endpoint. This step covers the rest of the
    // anonymous surface with sn_ws.RESTMessageV2 and no credentials at all - and it
    // does so WITHOUT persisting anything.
    //
    // It used to POST a VALID submission here. The endpoint accepted it, and because
    // an outbound call made from a script is NOT ATF-instrumented, the row guest
    // created that way sat OUTSIDE the rollback context: this test's own cleanup
    // delete ran inside the ATF transaction, the rollback reversed that delete, and
    // every run left one publicly lookup-addressable synthetic case behind, which
    // repeat runs accumulated. A test may not leave mutated state behind, and no
    // teardown available to it runs after the rollback in its own transaction without
    // either holding credentials or adding a second anonymous write surface to the
    // application. So the assertions below are non-mutating:
    //
    //   1. An unauthenticated POST carrying a body the handler MUST reject. A 401 or
    //      403 would come from the authenticator, ahead of the handler, so the
    //      handler's own verbatim validation message coming back proves both that the
    //      endpoint serves an anonymous caller and that its validation perimeter runs
    //      for one. A JSON array is the body used, because submitCase() rejects any
    //      non-object payload before it touches GlideRecord - see
    //      ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml - so nothing can be
    //      written. A JSON array remains the chosen body because it is the ONE
    //      rejection whose message the handler owns verbatim: submitCase() answers a
    //      non-object payload with exactly 'Invalid payload.', asserted below. The
    //      alternatives all changed after the validation gate was added to
    //      submitCase() and the body parse was guarded in the operation script: an
    //      EMPTY body and a body missing any mandatory field are now both refused
    //      with HTTP 400 and create nothing (they used to be accepted and WOULD have
    //      created a row), and unparseable text is now caught by the operation
    //      script and answered HTTP 400 'Request body must be valid JSON.' instead of
    //      escaping as HTTP 500. Their messages are the field-level validation
    //      envelope rather than a single verbatim string, so they are less precise to
    //      assert on than the array.
    //   2. The case step 2 submitted, read back through the anonymous lookup endpoint
    //      with no credentials: the portal round trip is reachable end to end by an
    //      unauthenticated caller, and the three-field whitelist holds for one.
    //   3. Proof that neither call made HERE persisted a row. Every credential-free
    //      call runs as guest, so a row caused here would be guest-owned. The census
    //      opens after step 2's row exists and excludes that row by sys_id, so it can
    //      only catch a row these two calls created, and it stays valid on an
    //      instance other work is also using. The two-second backdate absorbs clock
    //      skew between this script and the sys_created_on the database stamps.
    var submitted = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    submitted.addQuery('subject', 'ATF-PORTAL-18 anonymous submission');
    submitted.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    submitted.setLimit(1);
    submitted.query();
    chkTrue('the case submitted in step 2 is readable', submitted.next());
    var submittedId = submitted.getUniqueValue();
    var submittedNumber = String(submitted.getValue('number'));
    chk('the submission step 2 made was itself served with no credentials, as guest',
        'guest', String(submitted.getValue('sys_created_by')));

    var sinceGdt = new GlideDateTime();
    sinceGdt.addSeconds(-2);
    var since = sinceGdt.getValue();

    var res = anonCall('post', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_submit', '[]');
    chkTrue('the unauthenticated submit was not challenged for credentials', res.status !== '401');
    chkTrue('the unauthenticated submit was not refused by authorization', res.status !== '403');
    chk('the unauthenticated submit reached the handler, which rejected the payload', '400', res.status);
    chk('the handler answered the anonymous caller with its own verbatim validation message',
        'Invalid payload.', String(envelope(res.body).error));

    var look = anonCall('get', '/api/x_casemgmt/case_status_lookup?number=' +
        encodeURIComponent(submittedNumber), null);
    chk('an unauthenticated caller can look that submitted case up', '200', look.status);
    var seen = envelope(look.body);
    chk('the anonymous lookup exposes EXACTLY the three whitelisted keys',
        'opened_date,status,subject', Object.keys(seen).sort().join(','));
    chk('the anonymous lookup returns the stored status', 'Draft', String(seen.status));
    chk('the anonymous lookup returns the stored subject', 'ATF-PORTAL-18 anonymous submission',
        String(seen.subject));
    // lookupCase() emits opened_date as the DISPLAY value, not the raw column: see
    // the block comment at the return statement of
    // ../script_includes/x_casemgmt_CasePortalService.xml and
    // ../docs/portal-pages.md. Emitting the raw column made this endpoint the only
    // surface quoting UTC, seven hours away from the instant staff read on the case
    // form, which AAP Section 0.7.3 Gate 5 does not permit. Both halves of the
    // contract are asserted, so a well-formed but WRONG date still fails: the
    // emitted string is character for character the display rendering of THIS
    // submitted case's opened_date, and read back through the session timezone it
    // denotes the same instant as the stored UTC column.
    var submittedDisplay = String(submitted.opened_date.getDisplayValue() || '');
    chkTrue('the submitted case renders an opened_date display value to compare against',
        submittedDisplay.length > 0);
    chk('the anonymous lookup returns the stored opened_date as its display value, character for character',
        submittedDisplay, String(seen.opened_date));
    var seenRoundTrip = new GlideDateTime();
    seenRoundTrip.setDisplayValue(String(seen.opened_date));
    chk('the returned opened_date denotes the same instant as the stored UTC column',
        submitted.getValue('opened_date'), String(seenRoundTrip.getValue()));

    var guestRows = [];
    var guestGr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    guestGr.addQuery('sys_created_by', 'guest');
    guestGr.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', since);
    guestGr.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', submittedId);
    guestGr.query();
    while (guestGr.next())
        guestRows.push(guestGr.getUniqueValue() + ' [' + guestGr.getValue('number') + ']');
    chk('neither call in this step persisted a case', '', guestRows.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence lines below were written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the values these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('step 2 submitted ' + submittedNumber + ' [' + submittedId + '] as ' +
        submitted.getValue('sys_created_by'));
    notes.push('anonymous POST [] -> ' + res.status + ' ' + res.body);
    notes.push('anonymous GET ' + submittedNumber + ' -> ' + look.status + ' ' + look.body);
    notes.push('further guest-owned cases created since ' + since + '=' + guestRows.length +
        (guestRows.length ? ' [' + guestRows.join(' ') + ']' : ''));
    notes.push('genuinely anonymous, non-mutating portal probe: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'genuinely anonymous, non-mutating portal probe', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>One Open and one In Progress case</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>aa792f649fe819a66363e7cbbe2d6516</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_aa792f649fe819a66363e7cbbe2d6516</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 13 - Prohibited transition: any status back to Draft">8f85ec769b09e59e6d761aa58891de74</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=aa792f649fe819a66363e7cbbe2d6516"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>aa792f649fe819a66363e7cbbe2d6516</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>1e7baabe67d07d8becd9b3493150e436</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "open",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "2c5e1c1b024c34d83ce0524539985203",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 open case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Open",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "wip",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "134fa9e9d8acc56cc113172b2535927f",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-13",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-13 in progress case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>aa792f649fe819a66363e7cbbe2d6516</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>8516b260dff453a3fbe625f58beadc1c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>10</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>bc34b79e61ef3334daa61513dd271496</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_bc34b79e61ef3334daa61513dd271496</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 11 - Task-closure gate blocks In Progress to Resolved with the verbatim message">c225a1c9cc36ac254b284caeea84a9ae</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=bc34b79e61ef3334daa61513dd271496"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>bc34b79e61ef3334daa61513dd271496</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>5189e83e05c4aff48d2f8b451548a8bf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "case",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 resolve gate case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "In Progress",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "fe86c9e48b0f34254fd53ac38091d62b",
            "prefix": "ATF-SM-11",
            "fields": {
                "case": "8eb58da796d8386b3ecc5493644a5911",
                "subject": "ATF-SM-11 open child task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>bc34b79e61ef3334daa61513dd271496</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>7205626d9b291ce4d8986ddf81be6b1d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_client_86c130f8d9751167631b8438610153ef
sys_update_xml.payload:
truefalseForm message hygiene for x_casemgmt_case (QA finding F14). On load, binds an input/change listener to the four mandatory fields (subject, status, description, requester_name) that calls g_form.clearMessages() when the user edits one, so the stale mandatory-field banner from a refused save is flushed before the next save writes its own. Prevents the accumulated, self-contradicting banners F14 reports (screen claiming Subject is empty while Subject contains text). Cannot erase a freshly written message - the flush happens on user edit, strictly before the next save - so the three verbatim AAP 0.7.4 state-machine banners still surface and still persist across a fresh reload. onLoad rather than onSubmit because the platform's client-side mandatory check aborts the submit before onSubmit client scripts run, and rather than onChange because sys_script_client.field holds a single field while this table has four mandatory fields.truefalsex_casemgmt_case_flush_stale_messages100sys_script_clientadmin2025-01-01 00:00:00global/86c130f8d9751167631b8438610153ef0x_casemgmt_case_flush_stale_messages82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5afsys_script_client_86c130f8d9751167631b8438610153efadmin2025-01-01 00:00:00x_casemgmt_case
