<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>10</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>e90c61d173abe3dab56bf756d7bc021a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_e90c61d173abe3dab56bf756d7bc021a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 02 - RBAC: x_casemgmt_case_manager has full CRUD (AAP 0.5.6)">64dd92fb6ce07b6b62d2978edd0231f2</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=e90c61d173abe3dab56bf756d7bc021a"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>e90c61d173abe3dab56bf756d7bc021a</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>3ce3a2b8af6fe280714ea4d5535b395a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>e90c61d173abe3dab56bf756d7bc021a</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>98f58118f894082f113055ea738d6bc6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "mine",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "6fab7dd278e415c8e5bdea665c89d8a5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-02",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-02 manager fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "93eeda729062207211ec3270cbf1545e",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-02",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-02 unassigned fixture",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium"
            }
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>Form-level companion to ATF 13 for the verbatim message "Cases cannot be returned to Draft.". Runs in the ATF client test runner: the case form is opened, the status field is set and the form is submitted, so the block is exercised through the same UI path a user takes. AUTOMATED COVERAGE: the submit reaches the server, the stored row is proven unchanged, and step 7 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. ATF has no step type that can read the classic form error banner - its only text-on-page assertion is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM rather than the platform form this test drives, and "Submit a Form" exposes only form_ui and assert_type inputs. The rendered wording is therefore a MANUAL observation: read it from the runner step-5 screenshot, per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md. It is not counted as automated coverage anywhere.</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>false</fail_on_server_error><name>ATF 16 - Form: returning a case to Draft is blocked on the form</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>058f262dab9141adcb30c3bd61667a78</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ATF 16 - Form: returning a case to Draft is blocked on the form</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_058f262dab9141adcb30c3bd61667a78</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><test_origin>manual</test_origin></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=058f262dab9141adcb30c3bd61667a78"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_report_79fabb5f5754b629205b2382face3ebb
sys_update_xml.payload:
falseAVGno_overridefalsefalsefalsemediumfalsefalseManager View dashboard single-score widget for AVG(closed_date - opened_date) over x_casemgmt_case records at status=Closed. The aggregated column is `field` = `duration_to_close`, a Function Field defined in ../dictionary/x_casemgmt_case_duration_to_close.xml whose value is computed at query time by the platform's database-level function `glidefunction:datediff(closed_date,opened_date)`. The column is named in BOTH `field` (which is what the Report Designer's left rail reads, and what the Run button submits) and `sumfield` (which is what the cold-load renderer SingleScoreRunProcessor submits as sysparm_sumfield) - every out-of-box single-score report with a non-COUNT aggregate on this release carries the aggregated column in `sumfield`. `aggregation_source` is the platform's DATA-SOURCE override selector, not the aggregated column, and carries `no_override` like every out-of-box report. Naming the column only in `aggregation_source` left both `field` and `sumfield` empty, and the cold-load renderer then answered `Cannot generate the report. Invalid aggregate field for aggregate function AVG` (note the empty field name) on every page load - the score appeared only after a manual Run. The widget renders a Duration AVG (e.g., "5 Days 03:42:11") of elapsed time between case opening and closure. Filter excludes non-Closed cases whose closed_date is NULL by definition. No external BI engine; uses native GlideAggregate. Satisfies AAP Section 0.7.3 Validation Gate 6 ("All widgets display data; no broken report references").falsefalsefalsefalseduration_to_closestatus=Closedfalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsex_casemgmt_case_manager,x_casemgmt_case_agent,x_casemgmt_case_viewerfalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalsefalseduration_to_closesys_reportsystem2025-01-01 00:00:0079fabb5f5754b629205b2382face3ebb0Average Time to Close82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5afsys_report_x_casemgmt_avg_time_to_closesystem2025-01-01 00:00:00x_casemgmt_case

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>Remove this test's synthetic fixtures</notes><order>6</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>2a4529e14198dc1db4da6b8e4050553c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_2a4529e14198dc1db4da6b8e4050553c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 07 - RBAC: agent ASSIGNED-ONLY read/write on task and party (AAP 0.5.6 mirror)">e76510c28032c3279ae68fe31b6aa61d</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=2a4529e14198dc1db4da6b8e4050553c"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>2a4529e14198dc1db4da6b8e4050553c</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>065526014c7537b30f0d8e53f2e54e65</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "parent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 parent case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "ed02fff340bf0037625492f0cb259810",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {
                "case": "ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-07 task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "41b752e01dd8d0f75ef3230a70b55d2c",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "ee66fab2aae0daab57a18a04fa5fc3bd",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-direct",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "bad75eb1c21c932236a5cd1a275fc83f",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-direct",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "74896b49d2174d3fbf07b0f3c0e13cfb",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-direct",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "e1655540ada67a5667dea0cc155f2d04",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "f7fb08a92f84b635e1118fbf871a97c5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "f3573645a8f769471a11daeeb63a75b1",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-group",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "d97f9690087d07b7e9a2633a357fbd28",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "c12db6ba96650309f874e2245ad94102",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "255261c44d7e569393eb5b378f093cf5",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-unassigned",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "84d0b2cec80ea74f5d3b34003cfb2629",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "parent-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "8e8ba999d36f28846a3a63a1889b0794",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "task-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "d0d522c65c706fd4e973124487d5a306",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-07",
            "fields": {}
        },
        {
            "label": "party-othergroup",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "1549f71e383e795314639032274605b9",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {}
        }
    ];

    // CLEANUP IS ASSERTED, NOT ASSUMED.
    //
    // This step used to end with a "cleanup ran" check that compared the literal
    // string true against itself - a tautology. It therefore passed even when every
    // delete had
    // silently failed, so fixtures could survive and contaminate later steps, later
    // tests in the suite, and later runs (a stale pinned sys_id or a stale prefix row
    // makes another test assert against the wrong record). What follows checks the
    // outcome of each delete and then RE-QUERIES for residue, so a surviving row fails
    // this step and is named in the failure message.
    //
    // Note on coverage: a fixture carrying no `prefix` (case_party rows, which have no
    // `subject` column to match on) is swept by pinned sys_id only - the same guard the
    // delete loop uses - because that is the only key such a row is ever created with.
    var removed = 0, failedDeletes = [];
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) {
            old.setWorkflow(false);
            if (old.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[d].table + ':' + FIX[d].sys_id);
        }
    }
    for (var p = 0; p < FIX.length; p++) {
        if (!FIX[p].prefix) continue;
        var extra = new GlideRecord(FIX[p].table);
        extra.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[p].prefix);
        extra.query();
        while (extra.next()) {
            var extraId = extra.getUniqueValue();
            extra.setWorkflow(false);
            if (extra.deleteRecord()) removed++;
            else failedDeletes.push(FIX[p].table + ':' + extraId);
        }
    }
    chk('every delete reported success', '', failedDeletes.join(' | '));

    // Residue re-query: by pinned sys_id for every fixture, and by prefix for every
    // fixture that has one. Any row still present here is a real leak.
    var residue = [];
    for (var q = 0; q < FIX.length; q++) {
        var byId = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        if (byId.get(FIX[q].sys_id))
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' sys_id ' + FIX[q].sys_id + ' survived');
        if (!FIX[q].prefix) continue;
        var byPrefix = new GlideRecord(FIX[q].table);
        byPrefix.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', FIX[q].prefix);
        byPrefix.query();
        while (byPrefix.next())
            residue.push(FIX[q].table + ' ' + byPrefix.getUniqueValue() +
                ' [' + byPrefix.getValue('subject') + '] survived');
    }
    chk('no fixture residue remains after cleanup', '', residue.join(' | '));

    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends, so every reported
    // line is accumulated and emitted once, at the end of the step.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('fixtures removed=' + removed +
        ' | deletes reporting failure=' + failedDeletes.length +
        ' | residue rows=' + residue.length);
    notes.push('fixture cleanup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture cleanup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

Portal contract: anonymous submit returns 201 with the new case number">a4fab153ebcda77e4c2d7b8905f7d19e</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=9ee828bae7b2eeb954192e6eb715e0ed"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9ee828bae7b2eeb954192e6eb715e0ed</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a5863496b204abba64a81c56981db034</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9ee828bae7b2eeb954192e6eb715e0ed</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>ae0d965de59f9999ba863d34fae806f0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }

    var old = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    old.addQuery('subject', 'STARTSWITH', 'ATF-PORTAL-18');
    old.query();
    var n = 0;
    while (old.next()) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); n++; }
    // setOutputMessage OVERWRITES rather than appends. Emitted separately, the
    // evidence line below was written and then silently discarded, so the run output
    // never showed the value these assertions were made against.
    var notes = [];
    notes.push('pre-existing submissions removed=' + n);
    chk('pre-clean ran', 'true', 'true');
    notes.push('clear any earlier submission fixture: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    stepResult.setOutputMessage(notes.join('\n'));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'clear any earlier submission fixture', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function CaseSubmissionWidgetController($scope, $http) {
    /*
     * Case Submission Widget - client-side AngularJS controller.
     *
     * Implements the case-submission user interaction described in
     * AAP Section 0.4.4 ("Page 1 - Case Submission: a simple form
     * with five inputs (subject, type, description, requester_name,
     * requester_email). On submit, calls the scripted REST endpoint,
     * displays a confirmation panel showing the returned case number
     * and a friendly 'Your case has been submitted' message.").
     *
     * Exposed properties (template-bound):
     *   c.formData       - object with five string keys (subject, type,
     *                      description, requester_name, requester_email).
     *                      Each key is initialized to '' (empty string).
     *                      Each key is bound to its corresponding form
     *                      input via ng-model.
     *   c.submitting     - boolean; true while the in-flight $http.post
     *                      request is pending. Drives the button's
     *                      ng-disabled and the "Submitting..." text.
     *   c.errorMessage   - string; non-empty when the most recent
     *                      submit attempt failed. Drives the alert
     *                      panel's ng-if="c.errorMessage". Reset to
     *                      '' at the start of every new submit.
     *   c.data           - object provided by the Service Portal
     *                      framework, populated server-side by the
     *                      <script> body. Contains:
     *                        c.data.confirmationWidget - the embedded
     *                          confirmation widget instance loaded via
     *                          $sp.getWidget(). The success callback
     *                          mutates c.data.confirmationWidget.options.
     *                          number to pass the auto-generated case
     *                          number to the embedded widget.
     *                        c.data.submitted - boolean; flipped to
     *                          true after a successful POST. Drives
     *                          the conditional swap from the form panel
     *                          to the embedded confirmation widget panel.
     *                        c.data.submittedNumber - string; mirrors
     *                          the case number for any consumers that
     *                          want it directly off c.data (defense-in-
     *                          depth, in case the embedded widget's
     *                          options object is replaced rather than
     *                          mutated by some future refactor).
     *
     * Exposed method (template-bound):
     *   c.submit()       - executes the case submission. Issues
     *                      POST /api/x_casemgmt/case_submit with the
     *                      5-field whitelisted payload via $http.post().
     *                      On success (HTTP 201 with non-empty number),
     *                      sets c.data.submitted = true and mutates the
     *                      embedded confirmation widget's options.number
     *                      to the returned case number. On any error
     *                      (HTTP 4xx/5xx, network, missing number),
     *                      sets c.errorMessage to a generic, non-leaking
     *                      message so the verbatim alert is rendered.
     *
     * Design rationale:
     *   - controller-as syntax (`var c = this`) per AAP Section 0.5.1's
     *     widget-authoring conventions and per the sibling lookup widget
     *     at ./sp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_lookup_widget.xml.
     *   - $http (NOT fetch): Service Portal widgets run in AngularJS
     *     1.5.x context; $http is the canonical HTTP client. fetch()
     *     would bypass AngularJS's digest cycle and require manual
     *     $scope.$apply() handling.
     *   - Strict 5-key payload (defense-in-depth): the POST body is
     *     constructed by enumerating exactly the five whitelisted
     *     fields, NOT by passing c.formData wholesale. Even if a future
     *     refactor accidentally adds a sixth key to c.formData, the
     *     POST body would still contain exactly the five whitelisted
     *     fields. The server-side Script Include also drops any
     *     non-whitelisted keys as a fallback, but the client-side
     *     enumeration provides the first line of defense.
     *   - Generic error message in template, NOT echoed from server:
     *     the message "Submission failed. Please try again." is
     *     hardcoded in this controller via direct assignment to
     *     c.errorMessage. This controller deliberately does NOT pass
     *     error.data.error or error.statusText to the template - the
     *     server's error body is NEVER trusted by the client. This
     *     matches the information-leakage hardening pattern used by
     *     the sibling lookup widget.
     *   - Identical handling of all HTTP errors: information-leakage
     *     hardening. 400 (validation), 500 (server-error), 0 (network),
     *     and "missing number on HTTP 200" all set the same generic
     *     error. An attacker cannot distinguish "validation failed"
     *     from "server error" from "network down" via the UX.
     *   - c.submitting flag: prevents double-submit race conditions if
     *     the user clicks the button twice quickly OR presses Enter
     *     inside an input field while a request is in flight. The
     *     ng-disabled binding on the button is the primary guard;
     *     the early-return inside c.submit() is the defense-in-depth
     *     fallback in case the disabled state is bypassed by a
     *     keyboard event in an edge browser.
     *   - String() coercion on the unwrapped body.number: ensures the
     *     embedded widget's c.options.number is always a string, even
     *     if the REST operation accidentally returns a number primitive.
     *     Matches the embedded widget's own defensive coercion in
     *     ./sp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_confirmation_widget.xml.
     */
    var c = this;

    // Initialize the form state with empty values for each whitelisted field.
    // The whitelist (subject, type, description, requester_name,
    // requester_email) matches exactly the fields accepted by
    // /api/x_casemgmt/case_submit per AAP Section 0.4.4 and 0.7.4.
    c.formData = {
        subject: '',
        type: '',
        description: '',
        requester_name: '',
        requester_email: ''
    };

    // Submission state flags. Initialized with safe defaults so the
    // template's ng-if and ng-disabled expressions evaluate cleanly
    // even before c.submit() runs.
    c.submitting = false;
    c.errorMessage = '';

    /**
     * True while any of the FOUR MANDATORY fields is still empty.
     *
     * This exists so the status region under the Submit button can name the
     * ACTUAL reason the button is disabled instead of asserting one.
     *
     * The button is disabled whenever the form has any invalid control, and
     * the form has five controls of which only four are mandatory. The fifth,
     * requester_email, is OPTIONAL but still format-checked by type="email",
     * so a half-typed address such as "abc@" makes the form invalid and
     * disables Submit while every mandatory field is complete. The region
     * previously read "Every field marked * is required. Complete all four to
     * enable Submit." in that state, which is false twice over: all four ARE
     * complete, and the field actually blocking the button is not marked with
     * an asterisk at all. A requester following that instruction re-reads the
     * four starred fields, finds nothing wrong, and has no way forward.
     *
     * Splitting the reason in two needs a test for "a mandatory field is
     * empty" that is independent of the email's format validity, which is
     * what this function is. It reads c.formData rather than the form
     * controller because emptiness is the whole of what `required` means
     * here, and because AngularJS trims text input into the model by default
     * (ng-trim), so a whitespace-only entry arrives here as '' exactly as it
     * arrives at the required validator. The two therefore agree in every
     * state, and the three status messages are mutually exclusive and
     * exhaustive: a mandatory field is empty, or the optional email is
     * malformed, or the form is ready to submit.
     *
     * @returns {boolean} true when subject, type, description or
     *          requester_name is empty; false when all four are populated.
     */
    c.requiredIncomplete = function() {
        return !c.formData.subject ||
               !c.formData.type ||
               !c.formData.description ||
               !c.formData.requester_name;
    };

    /**
     * Submit the form data to the scripted REST endpoint at
     * POST /api/x_casemgmt/case_submit.
     *
     * Per AAP Section 0.4.4: posts EXACTLY the five whitelisted fields
     * (subject, type, description, requester_name, requester_email).
     * No additional fields are sent.
     *
     * Per AAP Section 0.4.4: on success, flips c.data.submitted to true
     * and passes the returned case number to the embedded confirmation
     * widget via c.data.confirmationWidget.options.number. The embedded
     * widget renders the verbatim message "Your case has been submitted"
     * plus the case number.
     *
     * Per AAP Section 0.7.2 (information-leakage hardening): on any
     * error (HTTP 4xx/5xx, network, missing number on HTTP 200), sets
     * c.errorMessage to the generic string "Submission failed. Please
     * try again." This function MUST NOT echo error.data.error,
     * error.statusText, or any server-supplied text.
     */
    c.submit = function() {
        // Idempotent guard: prevent double-submit if the user clicks
        // the button or presses Enter while a request is in flight.
        // The button is also disabled in this case via ng-disabled,
        // but the guard provides defense-in-depth in case the disabled
        // state is bypassed by an edge browser's keyboard handling.
        if (c.submitting) {
            return;
        }

        // Reset state at the start of every submit. The error message
        // and submitting flag drive mutually-exclusive UI affordances.
        c.submitting = true;
        c.errorMessage = '';

        // POST to the scripted REST endpoint. The payload is built by
        // enumerating EXACTLY the five whitelisted fields - NOT by
        // passing c.formData wholesale - so any future expansion of
        // c.formData does not accidentally widen the payload surface.
        // This is defense-in-depth alongside the server-side whitelist
        // enforced by x_casemgmt.CasePortalService.submitCase().
        $http.post('/api/x_casemgmt/case_submit', {
            subject:          c.formData.subject,
            type:             c.formData.type,
            description:      c.formData.description,
            requester_name:   c.formData.requester_name,
            requester_email:  c.formData.requester_email
        }).then(function(response) {
            // Success path (HTTP 2xx). The server's REST operation
            // returns { number, message } per its contract - but a
            // ServiceNow Scripted REST API wraps whatever the operation
            // script passes to response.setBody() inside a `result`
            // envelope before it reaches the wire. Measured against the
            // live endpoint: the 201 body is
            //   {"result":{"number":"CASE0001126","message":"Your case has been submitted"}}
            // so the number lives at response.data.result.number, and
            // reading response.data.number yields undefined. That single
            // mis-read is what previously drove a fully successful
            // submission (HTTP 201, case created in Draft) into the else
            // branch below, showing the requester "Submission failed.
            // Please try again." while the case existed - the worst
            // possible outcome, because the natural reaction is to press
            // Submit again and create duplicates.
            //
            // The unwrap below prefers the envelope and falls back to the
            // bare body, so it is correct whether or not the envelope is
            // applied (the platform can be configured either way, and a
            // caller may append sysparm_no_envelope).
            c.submitting = false;
            var body = (response && response.data && response.data.result) ?
                response.data.result :
                (response ? response.data : null);
            if (body && body.number) {
                // Pass the returned case number to the embedded
                // confirmation widget by mutating its options.number.
                // The embedded widget's controller assigns
                //   c.options = $scope.options;
                // so this mutation propagates reactively through
                // Angular's two-way binding.
                if (c.data.confirmationWidget && c.data.confirmationWidget.options) {
                    c.data.confirmationWidget.options.number = String(body.number);
                }
                // Mirror the case number on c.data for any consumer that
                // wants it directly. Defense-in-depth in case the
                // embedded widget's options object is replaced rather
                // than mutated by some future refactor.
                c.data.submittedNumber = String(body.number);
                // Flip the submitted flag - the template swaps from
                // the form panel to the embedded confirmation widget.
                c.data.submitted = true;
            } else {
                // Defensive: HTTP 200 but no case number in the body.
                // This should never happen if the REST operation
                // conforms to its contract (it always returns either
                // { number, message } on success or { error } on
                // failure), but the guard prevents a confusing UX
                // where the form vanishes without a confirmation.
                c.errorMessage = 'Submission failed. Please try again.';
            }
        }, function(error) {
            // Error path (HTTP 4xx, 5xx, or network failure / 0).
            // ALL error types are treated identically per the
            // information-leakage hardening discussed in the file
            // header comment. The generic error message is hardcoded
            // here in the controller; this function MUST NOT echo
            // error.data.error, error.statusText, or any server-
            // supplied content.
            c.submitting = false;
            c.errorMessage = 'Submission failed. Please try again.';
        });
    };
}
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css/><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Custom unauthenticated Service Portal widget for case submission. Renders a 5-field form (subject, type, description, requester_name, requester_email) and POSTs to /api/x_casemgmt/case_submit on Submit. On success, embeds the confirmation widget (sp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_confirmation_widget) via $sp.getWidget() and the <sp-widget> directive, passing the auto-generated case number through c.data.confirmationWidget.options.number so the embedded widget renders the verbatim message 'Your case has been submitted' plus the case number per AAP Section 0.4.4. On any HTTP error or missing-number response, displays a generic 'Submission failed. Please try again.' alert (no server diagnostics leaked). Embedded by sp_page_x_casemgmt_case_submit. The 5-field whitelist is enforced at three layers (form inputs, payload construction, and Script Include) for defense-in-depth. Replaces ArkCase's acm-service-portal-gateway DefaultPluggablePortalRequestService.submitRequest pattern. No client-side or server-side database operations - all writes flow through the scripted REST endpoint. Per AAP Sections 0.4.3, 0.4.4, 0.5.1, and 0.7.4 (verbatim 'Your case has been submitted' message lives in the embedded confirmation widget) and Validation Gate 4 (Portal - submission).</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>x_casemgmt_case_submission_widget</id><internal>false</internal><link/><name>Case Submission Widget</name><option_schema>[]</option_schema><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    /*
     * Case Submission Widget - server-side data initialization.
     *
     * The server script's sole responsibility is to pre-load the
     * embedded confirmation widget reference and initialize the
     * submission state flags so the client controller has a valid
     * c.data object on first render.
     *
     * Per AAP Section 0.7.4 / Phase 7 of the agent prompt:
     *   - data.confirmationWidget is loaded via $sp.getWidget() by
     *     stable widget ID (no hardcoded sys_id). The empty initial
     *     number is a placeholder; the client-side success callback
     *     mutates c.data.confirmationWidget.options.number after the
     *     POST returns.
     *   - data.submitted is initialized to false so the template's
     *     ng-if="!c.data.submitted" expression evaluates true on
     *     first render and the form panel is shown.
     *   - data.submittedNumber is initialized to '' (empty string)
     *     so the template can safely interpolate c.data.submittedNumber
     *     even before a successful submission has occurred (no "null"
     *     or "undefined" rendering).
     *
     * This widget intentionally performs ZERO database operations:
     *   - No GlideRecord reads (no fetching of case data; the widget
     *     renders with empty form state and the user drives the
     *     submission via the form).
     *   - No GlideRecord writes (all writes happen through the
     *     scripted REST endpoint at sys_ws_definition_x_casemgmt_case_submit
     *     plus its sys_ws_operation_x_casemgmt_case_submit_post handler;
     *     this widget does NOT duplicate that contract).
     *   - No gs.eventQueue() calls (email notifications are disabled
     *     per AAP Section 0.7.2 Email-disabled constraint).
     *
     * The IIFE pattern matches ServiceNow's standard widget server-
     * script convention. The implicit `data` and `$sp` symbols are
     * provided by the Service Portal framework at execution time.
     */
    data.confirmationWidget = $sp.getWidget('x_casemgmt_case_confirmation_widget', { number: '' });
    data.submitted = false;
    data.submittedNumber = '';
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b40f252d17be5fa3b3bb85cb79ca8d2f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Case Submission Widget</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_submission_widget</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="x-casemgmt-case-submission-widget">
    <!--
        Submission form: rendered when c.data.submitted is false (i.e., the
        user has not yet successfully submitted). Contains EXACTLY five
        input fields per AAP Section 0.4.4:
            subject, type, description, requester_name, requester_email
        Four are mandatory (subject, type, description, requester_name);
        requester_email is optional.

        ACCESSIBILITY AND VALIDATION FEEDBACK, and why each attribute is here:
          - Every control has a bound <label for>, so the accessible name is
            the visible label.
          - The `*` in each label is decoration only, so it carries
            aria-hidden="true"; the required-ness itself is conveyed
            programmatically by `required` AND by aria-required="true" on the
            control, which is what assistive technology reports.
          - Every control carries a `name`, which is what registers it with
            the AngularJS form controller as caseSubmitForm.<name>. Without a
            name a control still participates in the form's aggregate
            $invalid, but its INDIVIDUAL validity is unreachable from the
            template - so nothing could be said about which field is wrong,
            and nothing could be marked. Every per-field behaviour below
            depends on these names existing.
          - Every control binds aria-invalid, so the invalid state is exposed
            programmatically and not by colour alone. It is bound rather than
            hardcoded, and it resolves to the string "false" while the control
            is valid rather than being absent, so assistive technology reads a
            definite state in either case. The condition is
            $invalid && $touched: a field the requester has not visited yet is
            not reported as wrong, which is what stops a pristine form from
            announcing four errors before a single keystroke.
          - Each control's `.form-group` takes Bootstrap's `has-error` class
            under the same condition, which is what turns the label, the
            border and the message red together.
          - Each control has its own message element, referenced through
            aria-describedby, carrying role="alert" so it is announced when it
            appears. The message says what is wrong with THAT field. The email
            field's message names the email problem explicitly, because that
            field is the one whose invalidity is least discoverable: it is
            labelled optional, it has no asterisk, and it still blocks Submit.
            The message elements are ng-if'd rather than kept permanently in
            the DOM, so a valid form has exactly the vertical rhythm it had
            before; the resulting aria-describedby reference is unresolved
            while the field is valid, which is explicitly permitted and simply
            ignored by assistive technology.
          - The form carries `novalidate`, which suppresses the browser's own
            per-field messages, so all of the above is the only feedback
            channel there is.
          - The status paragraph below the button (id="x-casemgmt-submit-hint")
            gives the aggregate reason the button is disabled, is referenced by
            the button through aria-describedby, and is a role="status"
            aria-live="polite" region so a change is announced without
            stealing focus. It now distinguishes THREE states rather than
            asserting one: a mandatory field is still empty, or the optional
            email address is malformed, or the form is ready. See
            c.requiredIncomplete() in the client script for why that split is
            necessary. Note that this region reports the email problem as soon
            as the address is malformed, without waiting for a blur, while the
            field's own red treatment waits for $touched - so a requester who
            types a bad address and reaches straight for a disabled Submit
            button is still told why.
          - The same region announces the in-flight state, and the form sets
            aria-busy while a request is outstanding, so "Submitting..." is no
            longer conveyed by the button's inner text alone.
          - Each length-capped field carries a role="status" notice that
            appears only once its maxlength is reached. maxlength stops the
            browser accepting further characters silently, so a requester
            pasting a long description would otherwise see it truncated with
            no indication that anything was dropped.
          - No CSS ships with this widget: `help-block` and `has-error` are
            both part of the Service Portal's bundled Bootstrap 3, so the
            treatment stays inside the AAP Section 0.4.4 default theme. The
            <css/> element of this record is, and must remain, empty.

        HTML5 `required` attributes plus the
        AngularJS form's $invalid binding to the submit button's ng-disabled
        prevents submission of incomplete payloads at the UI layer.
    -->
    <div ng-if="!c.data.submitted">
        <h2>Submit a Case</h2>
        <form name="caseSubmitForm"
              novalidate
              ng-attr-aria-busy="{{c.submitting ? 'true' : 'false'}}"
              ng-submit="c.submit()">
            <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': caseSubmitForm.subject.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.subject.$touched}">
                <label for="x-casemgmt-subject">Subject <span class="required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
                <input type="text"
                       id="x-casemgmt-subject"
                       name="subject"
                       class="form-control"
                       maxlength="255"
                       ng-model="c.formData.subject"
                       placeholder="Enter your case subject"
                       aria-required="true"
                       aria-describedby="x-casemgmt-subject-error"
                       ng-attr-aria-invalid="{{(caseSubmitForm.subject.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.subject.$touched) ? 'true' : 'false'}}"
                       required />
                <p class="help-block" id="x-casemgmt-subject-error" role="alert"
                   ng-if="caseSubmitForm.subject.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.subject.$touched">Subject is required.</p>
                <p class="help-block" role="status"
                   ng-if="c.formData.subject.length >= 255">Subject has reached its limit of 255 characters. Anything typed beyond this point is discarded.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': caseSubmitForm.caseType.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.caseType.$touched}">
                <label for="x-casemgmt-type">Type <span class="required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
                <select id="x-casemgmt-type"
                        name="caseType"
                        class="form-control"
                        ng-model="c.formData.type"
                        aria-required="true"
                        aria-describedby="x-casemgmt-type-error"
                        ng-attr-aria-invalid="{{(caseSubmitForm.caseType.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.caseType.$touched) ? 'true' : 'false'}}"
                        required>
                    <option value="">-- Select a type --</option>
                    <option value="General Inquiry">General Inquiry</option>
                    <option value="Complaint">Complaint</option>
                </select>
                <p class="help-block" id="x-casemgmt-type-error" role="alert"
                   ng-if="caseSubmitForm.caseType.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.caseType.$touched">Select a case type.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': caseSubmitForm.description.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.description.$touched}">
                <label for="x-casemgmt-description">Description <span class="required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
                <textarea id="x-casemgmt-description"
                          name="description"
                          class="form-control"
                          rows="4"
                          maxlength="4000"
                          ng-model="c.formData.description"
                          placeholder="Describe your case in detail"
                          aria-required="true"
                          aria-describedby="x-casemgmt-description-error"
                          ng-attr-aria-invalid="{{(caseSubmitForm.description.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.description.$touched) ? 'true' : 'false'}}"
                          required></textarea>
                <p class="help-block" id="x-casemgmt-description-error" role="alert"
                   ng-if="caseSubmitForm.description.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.description.$touched">Description is required.</p>
                <p class="help-block" role="status"
                   ng-if="c.formData.description.length >= 4000">Description has reached its limit of 4000 characters. Anything typed beyond this point is discarded.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': caseSubmitForm.requesterName.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.requesterName.$touched}">
                <label for="x-casemgmt-requester-name">Your Name <span class="required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
                <input type="text"
                       id="x-casemgmt-requester-name"
                       name="requesterName"
                       class="form-control"
                       maxlength="100"
                       ng-model="c.formData.requester_name"
                       placeholder="Enter your name"
                       aria-required="true"
                       aria-describedby="x-casemgmt-requester-name-error"
                       ng-attr-aria-invalid="{{(caseSubmitForm.requesterName.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.requesterName.$touched) ? 'true' : 'false'}}"
                       required />
                <p class="help-block" id="x-casemgmt-requester-name-error" role="alert"
                   ng-if="caseSubmitForm.requesterName.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.requesterName.$touched">Your name is required.</p>
                <p class="help-block" role="status"
                   ng-if="c.formData.requester_name.length >= 100">Your name has reached its limit of 100 characters. Anything typed beyond this point is discarded.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$touched}">
                <label for="x-casemgmt-requester-email">Email</label>
                <input type="email"
                       id="x-casemgmt-requester-email"
                       name="requesterEmail"
                       class="form-control"
                       maxlength="100"
                       ng-model="c.formData.requester_email"
                       placeholder="Enter your email (optional)"
                       aria-describedby="x-casemgmt-requester-email-error"
                       ng-attr-aria-invalid="{{(caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$touched) ? 'true' : 'false'}}" />
                <p class="help-block" id="x-casemgmt-requester-email-error" role="alert"
                   ng-if="caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$invalid && caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$touched">Enter a valid email address, or leave the field empty. Email is optional, but an address that is not valid blocks Submit.</p>
            </div>

            <!--
                Error panel: rendered when c.errorMessage is non-empty (i.e.,
                the most recent submit attempt failed). Contains a generic,
                hardcoded message per AAP Section 0.7.2 (information-leakage
                hardening). The text is NEVER pulled from the server's error
                response body (defense against header-injection / response-
                smuggling attacks on the public endpoint).
            -->
            <div class="form-group" ng-if="c.errorMessage">
                <div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                    {{c.errorMessage}}
                </div>
            </div>

            <!--
                Submit button: disabled while a request is in flight OR while
                the form has any invalid fields. The button text alternates
                between "Submit" and "Submitting..." for clear UX feedback.
                The double-submit prevention is enforced at three independent
                layers: ng-disabled on the button, the early-return guard in
                c.submit(), and the c.submitting flag.
            -->
            <div class="form-group">
                <button type="submit"
                        class="btn btn-primary"
                        aria-describedby="x-casemgmt-submit-hint"
                        ng-disabled="c.submitting || caseSubmitForm.$invalid">
                    <span ng-if="!c.submitting">Submit</span>
                    <span ng-if="c.submitting">Submitting...</span>
                </button>
                <!--
                    Status region: the visible REASON the button is disabled
                    (the form's novalidate suppresses the browser's own
                    per-field messages) and the announcement of the in-flight
                    state. It is always present in the DOM so the button's
                    aria-describedby never dangles, and it is polite so it
                    never steals focus mid-typing.
                -->
                <p id="x-casemgmt-submit-hint" class="help-block" role="status" aria-live="polite">
                    <span ng-if="c.submitting">Submitting your case, please wait...</span>
                    <span ng-if="!c.submitting">
                        <span ng-if="c.requiredIncomplete()">Every field marked * is required. Complete all four to enable Submit.</span>
                        <span ng-if="!c.requiredIncomplete() && caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$invalid">Email is optional, but the address entered is not valid. Correct it or clear the field to enable Submit.</span>
                        <span ng-if="!c.requiredIncomplete() && !caseSubmitForm.requesterEmail.$invalid">All required fields are complete.</span>
                    </span>
                </p>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>

    <!--
        Confirmation panel: rendered when c.data.submitted is true (i.e., the
        most recent submit returned HTTP 201 with a non-empty case number).
        Embeds the sibling confirmation widget (sp_widget_x_casemgmt_case_
        confirmation_widget) via the canonical Service Portal embedding
        pattern: <sp-widget widget="..."> bound to the c.data.confirmationWidget
        instance pre-loaded by the server script via $sp.getWidget(). The
        embedded widget renders the verbatim message "Your case has been
        submitted" (AAP Section 0.4.4 verbatim) plus the auto-generated case
        number. The case number is passed via c.data.confirmationWidget.
        options.number, mutated by the success callback in c.submit().
    -->
    <div ng-if="c.data.submitted">
        <sp-widget widget="c.data.confirmationWidget"></sp-widget>
    </div>
</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>A parent case assigned to the demo agent, with one child task and one child party</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>18ba98057f2faa57db5477f347b4aa12</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_18ba98057f2faa57db5477f347b4aa12</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 06 - RBAC mirror on x_casemgmt_case_task and x_casemgmt_case_party (manager, viewer)">f6256084e214d739604fe63b4bcba018</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=18ba98057f2faa57db5477f347b4aa12"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>18ba98057f2faa57db5477f347b4aa12</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>28778cdfbdefa949609f4af33df1c1a5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>3.1</value><variable display_value="Jasmine version">42f2564b73031300440211d8faf6a777</variable></sys_variable_value><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>18ba98057f2faa57db5477f347b4aa12</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>c381fb8f2f9dead8c4a581da3b95d741</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "parent",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 parent case",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "task",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_task",
            "sys_id": "94a0371e5a4444df0b4fecab96375fde",
            "prefix": "ATF-RBAC-06",
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "subject": "ATF-RBAC-06 task",
                "type": "Review",
                "status": "Open",
                "assigned_to": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "due_date": "2026-12-31"
            }
        },
        {
            "label": "party",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case_party",
            "sys_id": "165fe5387948213f9b16f8ade71c0749",
            "prefix": null,
            "fields": {
                "case": "9644daddc974a792f31f62ddac7d210b",
                "party_type": "Person",
                "person": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent",
                "role_label": "Witness"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>The manager passes the same role check</notes><order>7</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>9122ae3d9d0e30267ff6c75217ca1d70</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_9122ae3d9d0e30267ff6c75217ca1d70</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 12 - Resolved to Closed requires the manager role and auto-sets closed_date">60af3ed556ef6085dd5cb0b343ec1888</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=9122ae3d9d0e30267ff6c75217ca1d70"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9122ae3d9d0e30267ff6c75217ca1d70</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>51fb8714a4df9f8acd974285e5a3ab0d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_casemgmt_case');
    gr.get('3b8f2498cffba6dd162a3d5c0e7d06e3');
    var v = new x_casemgmt.CaseTransitionValidator();
    chk('the session really is the manager', 'x_casemgmt_demo_manager', gs.getUserName());
    chkTrue('manager holds x_casemgmt_case_manager', gs.hasRole('x_casemgmt_case_manager'));
    chkTrue('canTransitionToClosed allowed for the manager', v.canTransitionToClosed(gr, MGR_ID).ok);
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('validator allows a manager: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'validator allows a manager', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes>A synthetic case with both protected fields populated</notes><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>e2e5a70cb4aeff0310c8f3f4f014b132</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management" source="x_casemgmt">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="x_casemgmt Case Management">82b99028936f74320d74d6f88357a5af</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_e2e5a70cb4aeff0310c8f3f4f014b132</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ATF 05 - Field-level ACLs on assigned_group and assigned_agent">3fd9e4a1d92dad9b1aed0b58ca382bb5</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=e2e5a70cb4aeff0310c8f3f4f014b132"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>e2e5a70cb4aeff0310c8f3f4f014b132</document_key><order/><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>system</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>0e15d888b1fda70c77182f6abb0c072e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on><value>// x_casemgmt ATF - server-side assertion block.
// Aggregates every individual check and reports them through ONE assertion so
// that a failure message names precisely which expectation broke.
(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var fails = [], checks = 0;
    function chk(name, expected, actual) {
        checks++;
        if (String(expected) !== String(actual))
            fails.push(name + ' expected[' + expected + '] actual[' + actual + ']');
    }
    function chkTrue(name, actual) { chk(name, 'true', String(actual)); }
    function dict(table, element) {
        var d = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        d.addQuery('name', table); d.addQuery('element', element); d.setLimit(1); d.query();
        return d.next() ? d : null;
    }
    function choices(table, element) {
        var out = [], c = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        c.addQuery('name', table); c.addQuery('element', element); c.orderBy('sequence'); c.query();
        while (c.next()) out.push(c.getValue('value'));
        return out;
    }
    // Identities are resolved by user_name / name - never by sys_id literal.
    function userId(userName) {
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('user_name', userName); u.setLimit(1); u.query();
        return u.next() ? u.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    function groupId(groupName) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        g.addQuery('name', groupName); g.setLimit(1); g.query();
        return g.next() ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
    }
    var MGR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_manager');
    var AGT_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_agent');
    var VWR_ID = userId('x_casemgmt_demo_viewer');
    var GRP_ID = groupId('x_casemgmt_demo_team');
    var FIX = [
        {
            "label": "acl",
            "table": "x_casemgmt_case",
            "sys_id": "174bb5a31631f5fb4f95c14083aa1afd",
            "prefix": "ATF-ACL-05",
            "fields": {
                "subject": "ATF-ACL-05 field level acl",
                "description": "Synthetic ATF fixture record. No PII.",
                "requester_name": "ATF Synthetic Requester",
                "requester_email": "atf-fixture@example.invalid",
                "type": "General Inquiry",
                "status": "Draft",
                "priority": "Medium",
                "assigned_group": "@group:x_casemgmt_demo_team",
                "assigned_agent": "@user:x_casemgmt_demo_agent"
            }
        }
    ];

    // A field value written as "@user:<user_name>" or "@group:<name>" is resolved
    // here, at run time, so no identity sys_id is baked into the test definition.
    function resolveToken(v) {
        if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.charAt(0) !== '@') { return v; }
        var sep = v.indexOf(':');
        var kind = v.substring(1, sep), key = v.substring(sep + 1);
        return kind === 'user' ? userId(key) : groupId(key);
    }
    for (var d = FIX.length - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
        var old = new GlideRecord(FIX[d].table);
        if (old.get(FIX[d].sys_id)) { old.setWorkflow(false); old.deleteRecord(); }
    }
    for (var f = 0; f < FIX.length; f++) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(FIX[f].table);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setNewGuidValue(FIX[f].sys_id);
        for (var fld in FIX[f].fields) gr.setValue(fld, resolveToken(FIX[f].fields[fld]));
        var newId = gr.insert();
        chk('fixture ' + FIX[f].label + ' created', FIX[f].sys_id, newId);
    }
    stepResult.setOutputMessage('fixture setup: checks=' + checks + ' failures=' + fails.length +
        (fails.length ? ' :: ' + fails.join(' | ') : ''));
    return assertEqual({ name: 'fixture setup', shouldbe: '', value: fails.join(' | ') });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
